about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Charles E. Schumer

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, well, first, about Trump's meeting with Xi and Putin, Trump calls the trilateral meeting with Xi and Putin ``historic.'' Yes, it is a historic embarrassment that people will remember long into the future.
From start to finish, Xi and Putin had Trump eating out of the palm of their hand all day long.
Trump greeted Putin--the dictator who is currently decimating the lives of Ukrainian citizens, who is abducting children, who is threatening America--by calling him ``my friend.'' Get this.

Nothing to stop the flow of fentanyl, nothing to keep our most advanced chips out of the PLA's hands, nothing to curb Chinese espionage into our companies, nothing to protect American manufacturers, nothing to end Russia's criminal invasion of Ukraine, nothing to stop China and Russia from helping Iran target our troops--nothing.
The summit was nothing but a glorified photo op and a gift to Putin and Xi.
Where he sits at the table means more than all of the American interests, American national security, the suffering of millions at Putin and Xi's hands.
Trump cares more about where he sits at the Chinese Communist Party's state dinner than where America sits in the international order.
The cost of everything on the Thanksgiving menu has skyrocketed because of Trump's disastrous war, his costly tariff taxes, and his idiotic trade war with Canada.
Working families will go hungry this Thanksgiving because Trump sold them out to give the biggest corporations and wealthiest Americans a tax cut.
Billionaires and trillionaires got a feast in Trump and the GOP's so-called Big Beautiful Bill, and working families are left with the scraps.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Artificial Intelligence Mr. President, and if you think this is bad, buckle up for the AI age, unless we act now to get ahead of the worst.

The report that the GAO put out this morning about the potential for bad actors to use common AI models to plan terrorist attacks and breach critical infrastructure ought to be a wake-up call for everyone, particularly so many in the administration who are thickheaded or just interested in sucking up to Trump.
China Mr. President, on Trump in China, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin are playing Donald Trump like a cheap violin.
The Chinese Communist Party rolled out the red carpet for Trump when he touched down in China earlier today, with Xi even hugging Trump on the tarmac.
Xi and Putin know that if they stroke Trump's ego and distract him with pomp and circumstance and flatter him a little bit, Trump will back down on the issues that matter to most Americans.
Trump should be pressuring Putin to stop his criminal invasion of Ukraine, not shaking hands with him as the Russian dictator actively batters Ukraine's energy infrastructure with winter approaching.
Give Putin a stiff arm, not a handshake.
I urge the administration to form the red team and report its findings to Congress by December 1.
I will be working closely with her, Senator Cantwell, Senator Warner, and other leaders from our caucus to protect the country from AI threats before it is too late.
We need to ensure the safe development and deployment of AI or we will see more outages or--God forbid--even a catastrophic event going forward.
Well, I will tell you this, Mullin: Most Americans living their lives don't fly in private jets on the taxpayers' dime so they don't miss out on their box tickets to the game.
We will be speaking for the next period of time.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Instead of focusing on strengthening our alliances in Southeast Asia to counter China, Trump is treating the ASEAN conference in the Philippines as little more than a layover on his way to meet with Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and potentially even Kim Jong Un.
Rather than spending this trip catering to Xi and Putin and overlooking our allies, Trump ought to toughen up.
To Trump, this White House spending spree is peanuts, but to working families, it is their paychecks.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: This morning, Pete Hegseth had the audacity to declare a ``historic military victory'' in Iran.
Iran and its proxies still taking potshots at passing ships 8 months into the war isn't a historic victory.
Trumpflation is busting working families' budgets, and for 2 years my Republican colleagues buried their heads in the sand.
Food prices skyrocketed to astronomical heights because of Trump's illegal war, his costly tariffs, and his nonsensical trade war with Canada.
Myself and colleagues have been pushing on this for quite a while, and I urge my Republican colleagues to come together with us to pass this legislation while we still can.
Well, Pete, we will be seeing you soon.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Americans were clear about wanting to end Trump's war, stop his tariffs, lower healthcare costs, ban both Members of Congress and the President from trading stocks and so much more, and Democrats are going to deliver.
Pete Hegseth Madam President, now, on the Pete Hegseth trial, Trump's disastrous war in Iran will go down as one of the greatest foreign policy fiascos in American history.
The Senate needs to put Pete Hegseth on trial so we can remove him for his catastrophic failure in Iran.
We are going to spend every second of every day striving to prove ourselves worthy of Americans' trust.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RATEPAYER PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: RATEPAYER PROTECTION ACT
sentences: Mr. President, now on the weak data center bill, the only thing that came out of Trump's big AI summit yesterday was a photo op; no Federal guardrails to protect against catastrophic risk, no signal from Trump that he plans to act.
Republicans' toothless data center bill completely misses the mark.

Senate Republicans would do nothing to require data center companies to pay for their rising costs in the surrounding communities; Senate Democrats want to make it mandatory for data centers to cover their own costs by law, not by suggestion or hope or whim.
The Republicans' legislation doesn't even apply to all data centers.

To put it simply: Republicans' data center bill follows Trump's lead in ignoring Americans' pressing concerns about AI while our legislation would actually address them with guardrails that have real teeth.
I urge my colleagues to join us in taking real action on AI.
I urge Republicans to put aside their feeble bill and put Americans over party. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
statements.title: STOP INSIDER TRADING ACT
sentences: Mr. President, on stock trading, only Senate Republicans would dare call a bill that permits Members of Congress to continue to own, sell, and in some instances buy stocks a stock trading ban.
The Republican bill is a permission slip for corruption, not a stock trading ban.
There has been a real bipartisan effort to ban Members of Congress from trading stocks and profiting off their insider information.
Last year, the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs advanced a strong bipartisan bill that would actually ban stocks, not pretend to do so.
Republicans want to explicitly allow Members to continue trading stocks in privately held companies, including in companies the Members oversee; a formula for disaster and corruption.
Under the Republican bill, Members would still get to own and sell stocks, and most importantly, this bill doesn't do anything--anything--to stop Donald Trump from trading stocks.
I guess Republicans forgot that Trump has made nearly 30,000 stock trades in the past year and raked in billions--more than all of Congress combined.
The Republican toothless stock trading bill is as ineffective as a screen door on a submarine.
This hollow bill isn't a stock trading ban; it is Republicans' last-ditch effort to save face.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Introductory Statement on S. 5619
statements.title: Introductory Statement on S. 5619
sentences: RESTORATION OF ALLOWANCE OF PREMIUM TAX CREDIT FOR LAWFULLY PRESENT INDIVIDUALS. (a) In General.--Section 71301 of Public Law 119-21 is repealed, and each provision of law amended by such section is amended to read as such provision would read if such section had never been enacted. (b) Effective Date.--Each amendment made by this section shall take effect as if included in the provision of Public Law 119-21 to which such amendment relates.

STATE OPTION TO INCREASE MAXIMUM HOUSEHOLD INCOME FOR BASIC HEALTH PROGRAM ELIGIBILITY. (a) In General.--Section 1331(e)(1)(B) of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (42 U.S.C. 18051(e)(1)(B)) is amended by striking ``200 percent'' and inserting ``a percentage to be determined by the State that is not less than 200 percent and not more than 250 percent''. (b) Effective Date.--The amendment made by this section shall apply with respect to plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027. ______

(b) Effective Date.--The amendment made by this section shall apply with respect to plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027. ______ By Mr. DURBIN (for himself, Ms. Duckworth, Mr. Padilla, and Mr. Schiff): S. 5632.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 119TH CONGRESS
statements.title: 119TH CONGRESS
sentences: The Trump administration, empowered by his feckless Republican majorities in Congress, has been a catastrophe for working families everywhere.
Americans have watched the price of everything--everything-- explode these past 2 years--groceries, gasoline, healthcare, electricity, housing, childcare.
Senate Republicans back Trump's horrendous tariff tax to the hilt.
Democrats fought Trump's tariff tax in court and won.
As Trump has pursued new tariffs, Republicans in Congress have abetted these tax increases on families and small businesses, while Democrats have pushed to end them.

We fought back when Trump and congressional Republicans gleefully cut $1 trillion--$1 trillion--from our healthcare system so they could cut taxes for billionaires and their biggest corporation friends.
Meanwhile, tens of millions of Americans with ACA coverage have to shell out more than $1,000 extra because of soaring premiums and deductibles.
Medicaid, food assistance--every program designed to help Americans keep their heads above water--all cut to the bones by Republicans in the Senate and in the country.
The Republican majority continues to back Trump's disastrous war with Iran that has made gas prices skyrocket and mortgage rates soar.
We fought hard to secure these investments, and you had better believe we are going to fight to bring them back.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
sentences: He has tried to disenfranchise millions of Americans, kill vote-by-mail, and make it harder for people to make their voices heard in their democracy.
Republicans tried to jam through Trump's SAVE Act--the most devious anti-voting rights legislation Trump ever dreamed up--to purge millions of voters from the rolls.
We told Republicans that the SAVE Act ain't going to happen.

We killed the SAVE Act in Congress, we took Trump to court over his attacks with his voter-suppression Executive orders, we protected mail-in voting, and we defeated Trump's attacks on our elections in case after case after case.

Senate Democrats launched our Election Protection Task Force to plan how we will protect our elections on election day from Trump, we held tabletop exercises to prepare for Trump's efforts to interfere with our elections, and we launched a historic Election Observer Program to train and deploy Senate staff volunteers across the country to monitor for any meddling in our electoral system.
We are fighting Trump tooth and nail on every front, but we are the first to recognize that stopping the worst of the worst isn't enough.
We know we need to build that trust with the Americans back up, and we will.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CORRUPTION
statements.title: CORRUPTION
sentences: Billions of dollars in upgrades to Trump's $400 million foreign luxury jet, Trump's gaudy triumphal arch and his billion-dollar ballroom, his recent propaganda ad, sweetheart deals for his sons' companies from foreign governments, his $2 billion MAGA slush fund to funnel American taxpayers' money to himself, his billionaire friends, and January 6 insurrectionists--the list, unfortunately, goes on and on and on, and Trump charged it all to the American taxpayer.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: The Senate GOP's response to AI risk has been almost as meek as Trump's.
Americans are demanding real guardrails on AI and data centers, but all the Republicans offer is a toothless messaging bill.
I can sum up the shortcomings of the Republican data center bill with one word: optional.
Here, we need some real action on data centers.

Well, they are the ones that need the guardrails: optional--optional requirements in his bill on data center development, optional standards for safety against catastrophic risks, optional enforcement to protect the American people.
Stock Trading Mr. President, on stock trading and voter ID, Senate Republicans continue to show the country they care more about playing partisan political games than stopping corruption.
The Senate GOP has bucked a longstanding bipartisan effort to ban stock trading in Congress, which is what Congress should do.

Last July--July--the Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee advanced a strong, commonsense, bipartisan bill to ban congressional stock trading, but Senate Republicans abandoned this effort.
If Senate Republicans truly cared about banning stock trading in Congress, they wouldn't have let the House Republicans water down the ban.
The bill even lets Members continue to own and sell stocks.
The Republican bill even lets Members continue to own and sell stocks.
The Republican bill also explicitly allows Members to trade stocks in privately held companies to profit off their insider knowledge.
So the bill makes things worse than present law because it would simply hide insider trading.
And if Senate Republicans cared about reining in stock trading, they would advance a bill that prohibits the President from trading stocks.
We know that Trump has traded more stocks than all of Congress combined, but this bill does no such thing.
If Republican Senators really cared about stopping stock trading by Members, they wouldn't have loaded it up with a poison pill voter ID bill, which Senate Democrats have defeated already twice.
Republicans know that no one in their right mind would ever go along with the draconian voting restrictions that they attach to their stock trading bill.
Trump is getting you, American taxpayer, to use your dollars to pay for his political ads.
After fawning over foreign authoritarians like Putin and Kim Jong Un for so long, Trump must have gotten jealous of their control over state TV.
Affordable Care Act Mr. President, finally, on the Affordable Care Act CRA, well, today Senate Democrats will force consideration of a resolution to stop Trump from further sabotaging the ACA.

As if Americans weren't drowning enough in Trump's failed economy, this callous rule comes on the heels of Trump and Republicans ransacking over $1 trillion--$1 trillion--from the healthcare system, all to bankroll tax breaks for billionaires and big corporations.
For years, Trump has tried to repeal and replace the Affordable Care Act with no idea of what replacement will look like whatsoever.
As Trump's economy bleeds the American people dry, Trump isn't trying to lower costs but, rather, kill the Affordable Care Act with a death by a thousand cuts.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Madam President, this is on the taxpayer-funded Trump political ads.

Rescissions Madam President, on the Trump rescissions, Trump has no problem wasting billions of American taxpayers on his vanity projects but suddenly gets stingy when there is an opportunity to support American families.
Trump's rescissions package eviscerated funding that supports kids, K through 12 students, small businesses, health, and clean air research.
Iran Madam President, finally on the Iran war, it now enters its eighth month, and Trump continues to drag America through the mess he has made in Iran.
Trump shows no signs of ending this war, not when he just launched a pledge for new strikes on Iran after the midterms.
Trump's costly war with Iran will end whenever Trump Republicans find the courage to listen to the American people instead of the hysteria from the President.
Republicans could have shown that courage last week by supporting our War Powers Resolution to stop the fighting in Iran and bring costs down.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: No President should be able to use censorship to escape accountability, to deprive Americans of the truth, and to take our country down the path to authoritarianism.
China Mr. President, on the Xi Jinping visit, Trump's soft-handed treatment of the Chinese Communist Party is on full display this week during Xi Jinping's visit.
Trump ought to take that trade war truce up north to Canada, instead of giving it to China and Xi and his authoritarian regime.
That is what Trump did for Putin in Alaska last year.
And now Trump and Rubio want to roll out the red carpet for Putin again at the G20 in Florida this year.
Iran Mr. President, on the Iran war, as Trump tries to tread water as his disastrous war with Iran gets worse by the day, the American people are drowning in costs.
Gas is nearly $4.50 a gallon, and diesel is still breaking highs at $6.51 a gallon because of Trump's war.
Working families are getting cleaned out at the grocery store counters.
All the while, Iran's grip on the Strait of Hormuz and other key chokepoints has grown tighter, and the entire situation in the Middle East has gotten worse.
And, of course, as I said, the price of gasoline and the price of diesel keep going up.
Well, Senate Democrats will force a vote on another War Powers Resolution to end Trump's disastrous war and bring our troops home, at last, very soon.

Just this morning, I joined Senator Whitehouse to unveil our Anti- corruption Working Group's staggering new report on how Trump's corrupt dealings with Big Oil billionaires are costing the American people a fortune.
Trump blocked clean energy projects that would have brought down families' energy costs and powered millions of homes.

The administration shut down the cheapest and fastest source of energy to build and get--the cheapest source of energy, the fastest source; it is the one that goes quickest on the grid--just so billionaires, Big Oil billionaires, could get even richer.
Every time Americans see the skyrocketing costs on their electric bill or at the gas station, they know who to blame: Donald Trump and his Big Oil billionaire cronies.

The chutzpah of a President to say, ``I am going to shut down the media because I don't like what they are saying,'' when he knows that 250 grand years of freedom of speech has been the hallmark of this country.
No, they brag about it: We will give you $1 billion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: For nearly 50 years, you could find Lee on the frontlines for every labor issue imaginable--equal pay, better benefits, safer working conditions.
He also made history as the union's first African-American president.
As Lee steered this mighty union, I have had the privilege of standing shoulder to shoulder with him on issue after issue after issue.
Together, we worked tirelessly to ensure that over 2 million public servants received their hard-earned Social Security benefits.

Together, we continue to fight for the PRO Act so that workers can better organize and bargain for fair wages and benefits, and we have applied that PRO Act in companion legislation for public workers.

I couldn't have asked for a better partner in the trenches, and AFSCME's members couldn't have elected a better president to stand up for their rights in the face of some of the greatest challenges to organized labor for generations.
Lee, you lit an eternal flame in the heart of the labor movement, and it will long endure no matter how hard corporate interests and union busters try to stamp it out.
As I have been warning not only for weeks but actually for years, Trump cannot let the Chinese Communist Party get its hands on our most advanced AI chips and manufacturing equipment.
It is almost like China is trying to sabotage American industry for decades to come.
Trump also needs to explain why on Earth he continued providing tariff relief to China, our main competitor, while escalating his costly trade war with Canada, one of our closest allies.
Crucially, there is real risk that Trump could let Xi off the hook for helping Russia and Iran evade sanctions, even helping Iran target American troops in the Middle East.
Today, I will pay tribute to a dear friend and a juggernaut for labor who recently began a well-deserved retirement--AFSCME president Lee Saunders.
We will be closely watching what Trump does across the spectrum of challenges that the United States faces with the PRC.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Introductory Statement on S. 5461
statements.title: Introductory Statement on S. 5461
sentences: Trump's blunder in Iran has jacked up the price of fertilizer and diesel to record highs, making it harder for farmers to do their jobs, from planting to harvest.
Meanwhile, Trump's costly trade wars and tariffs have raised the cost of farm equipment and, worst of all, closed off markets for our farmers to sell their products.
Farm bankruptcies are increasing because of the tariffs and the markets that Trump closed off.
Many farmers were already struggling to get by, and now 70 percent of them say they haven't been able to afford the fertilizer they need, all because of Trump's Iran war.
Our bill directs the USDA to explore creating a strategic fertilizer reserve to help American farmers weather supply chain shocks by Trump's Iran war.
(B) Staggered terms.--The terms of the members of the Board shall be staggered so that the terms of not more than 3 members expire in any single year.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STATEMENTS ON INTRODUCED BILLS AND JOINT RESOLUTIONS
statements.title: STATEMENTS ON INTRODUCED BILLS AND JOINT RESOLUTIONS
sentences: Trump's blunder in Iran has jacked up the price of fertilizer and diesel to record highs, making it harder for farmers to do their jobs, from planting to harvest.
Meanwhile, Trump's costly trade wars and tariffs have raised the cost of farm equipment and, worst of all, closed off markets for our farmers to sell their products.
Farm bankruptcies are increasing because of the tariffs and the markets that Trump closed off.
Many farmers were already struggling to get by, and now 70 percent of them say they haven't been able to afford the fertilizer they need, all because of Trump's Iran war.
Our bill directs the USDA to explore creating a strategic fertilizer reserve to help American farmers weather supply chain shocks by Trump's Iran war.
(B) Staggered terms.--The terms of the members of the Board shall be staggered so that the terms of not more than 3 members expire in any single year.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Artificial Intelligence (Executive Session)
statements.title: Artificial Intelligence (Executive Session)
sentences: After rambling on about how he wants to rename artificial intelligence ``superintelligence,'' Trump said he will oppose--oppose--any global effort to regulate AI.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Before Trump meets with Xi Jinping next week, he needs to draw a line in the sand and say that blocking the Chinese Communist Party's access to our cutting-edge AI technology is nonnegotiable.
Yesterday, the Federal Reserve increased interest rates for the first time in 3 years to fight Trumpflation fueled by the President's tariffs and the disastrous war against Iran.
Instead of doing anything to bring down costs, to stop his tariffs, to end his war, Trump does what he always does and calls ``affordability'' a ``made up'' word.
Just yesterday, I pushed to pass my legislation to end Trump's tariff tax and deliver some relief to American families.

That was the Republicans' first chance to lower costs for Americans since we have been back from our State activities for 5 weeks, and based on their schedule, it is also likely Republicans' last opportunity to stop Trump's costly tariffs before election day.
Again, the bottom line: This may have been the last opportunity to get rid of these tariffs, which are raising Americans' costs, before Leader Thune calls the session to a close.
Iran Mr. President, finally, on the Iran war, well, Trump continues to downplay the severe costs of his failed war in Iran.

But, yesterday, campaigning in North Carolina, Trump said the hundreds of billions of dollars he is burning on this war is ``a very inexpensive price''-- those are his words--``to pay for what we've done'' in Iran--spoken like a billionaire who has never filled his own gas tank 1 day in his life.
Earth to Trump: $4.50 a gallon for gas and a record $6.40 a gallon for diesel isn't inexpensive for working Americans.
Is it the Iranian regime in Tehran that is even more radical than before the war?
Is it Iran's tightening grip on the Strait of Hormuz and other key shipping choke points.
The only thing Trump has done in Iran is make everything worse.

Senate Democrats--make no mistake about it--Senate Democrats will push for another vote on a War Powers Resolution next week to bring our troops home and will continue to force votes until Trump ends his Iranian blunder.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, first on tariffs, the American people are getting absolutely slammed by Trump's tariff tax.
So, later today, I will ask consent to vote on my End Trump's Tariff Tax Act to stop the President from bleeding Americans dry with skyrocketing costs.
My legislation would roll back Trump's latest salvo with tariff taxes--including the severe ones he just put on Canada--and refund the Americans who have been ripped off.
Trump's tariffs are hitting all Americans hard.
Our farmers are getting hammered, but no one is bearing the brunt more than our northern border States.
How could Trump possibly think that launching a nonsensical trade war with Canada, whose economy is so intertwined with so many of our northern States, would go well?
Trump's tariffs have cost States like Michigan, Maine, New York the equivalent of thousands of dollars per family.
Senate Republicans, I say to my colleagues once again: Are you willing to go along with Trump on these ridiculous tariffs?
Iran Mr. President, now speaking of costs, the cost of the Iran war.
The American people are still paying the price for Trump's incompetence 7 months into a disastrous war with Iran that he said would only take days.

Take a look at the headline: ``Independent Budget Office Estimates Iran War Has Cost $38 Billion'' and ``Americans Have Spent $100 Billion More on Fuel During the Iran War,'' from the Times and the Wall Street Journal.
The CBO's $38 billion estimate only measures through August 1 and doesn't include any of the costs involved with repairing the vast damage Iran has inflicted on our bases in the region.
The sticker price on Trump's disaster on Iran doesn't even include how much the war has sent Americans' costs skyrocketing.
So that is what the other headline says: ``Americans Have Spent $100 Billion More on Fuel During the Iran War.'' The cost of diesel just hit a record high.
Donald, you can try helping Putin and blaming the Ukrainians for high gas prices all you want, but no one is buying your BS; just look at the polling.
So given all of this, are Senate Republicans going to keep backing Trump and his blunder in Iran?

On multiple occasions, Democrats have led this Congress to pass War Powers Resolutions to end the hostilities in Iran and will soon force another vote on a War Powers Resolution to stop the fighting and get our troops out of harm's way.

I know our Republican colleagues don't like it to have to vote again and again and again to embrace and ratify Trump's war in Iran, but you are going to have to keep doing it until you join us in forcing Trump to end this awful war.
If Trump continues his current course in Iran, I can promise you this as well: The costs will just keep piling up.
And we will continue to force those votes so long as this war continues.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT OF 2026--Motion to Proceed
statements.title: PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT OF 2026--Motion to Proceed
sentences: Interest Rates Mr. President, just for a moment before I talk about my UC on tariffs, I just noted that the Federal Reserve Board had raised interest rates.
Unanimous Consent Request--S. 5390 Mr. President, now on the UC on the tariff bill, so, as I mentioned, Donald Trump continues to wring every last dollar he can.
He wrings every last dollar he can from working families with his tariff taxes.
And based on Republican's schedule, this could be the last chance to lower costs before election day, when it comes to tariffs.
Republicans better ditch these tariffs, especially since we just learned everything is about to become more expensive in America, now that interest rates are going up for the first time in 3 years.
This bill would reverse Trump's efforts to bleed the American people dry with tariffs and refund the families that he has gouged at every turn.
Costs are skyrocketing, tens of thousands of factory workers are losing their jobs, and small businesses and family farms are all going under--all because Donald Trump refuses to drop his trade war.
And, somehow, who is our No. 1 enemy right now when it comes to this trade war?
He doesn't say the war in Iran.

Trump thinks he is sticking it to Canada with his tariffs, but he is really twisting the knife on working families from Maine, to Michigan, to the North Country and Buffalo in New York and on to Washington State and everywhere in between.
These Northern States that have borders or proximity to Canada are being clobbered by these tariffs.
And ask the Americans, ask New Yorkers along that border if they think their problems are solved by renaming Lake Ontario.
No. Their problems are made worse by these tariffs because they are paying the bill.
So as Americans shell out thousands of dollars in extra costs because of Trump's tariff tax, Trump calls affordability a ``fake word,'' a ``hoax.'' Is that what our Senate Republicans think too?

If Republicans truly care about lowering high costs that are crushing American families, much of which are caused by his tariff regime, they ought to put their money where their mouth is and support the end to Trump's tariff tax.

So, Mr. President, notwithstanding rule XXII, I ask unanimous consent that the Committee on Finance be discharged from further consideration of S. 5390, the End Trump's Tariff Tax Act, and the Senate proceed to its immediate consideration; further, that the bill be considered read a third time and passed and that the motion to reconsider be considered made and laid upon the table.

Mr. President, I just want to say once again that Americans keep getting hit by a double whammy--these tariffs, particularly when it comes to those on the Canadian border, and now the rise in interest rates.
We will see the results of their being so fed up in early November.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Artificial Intelligence (Executive Session)
statements.title: Artificial Intelligence (Executive Session)
sentences: So the American people keep calling on their government to act on AI, which even its creators are saying is increasingly dangerous, but Donald Trump couldn't care less.
Families say they are getting crushed at the gas pump because of Trump's war in Iran.
We need transparency into how the administration is testing powerful frontier AI models, something they have been concealing from the public since announcing the framework months ago.

Wedding of Donald Trump, Jr. Mr. President, on the Trump family's Russia corruption--there is so much of it--on the same day Trump decided to put pressure on Ukraine rather than Russia by blaming Ukraine--not his disastrous Iran war--for high gas prices, we continue to see evidence that the Trump family is in Putin's pocket.
It came out yesterday that a Russian oligarch with close ties to Putin footed the bill for hundreds of thousands of dollars in wedding expenses for Donald Trump, Jr. Can you believe this?
An oligarch of a country we oppose is paying for the wedding of the President's son.
[S]ometimes a wedding gift is simply a wedding gift.
Well, I say to Donald Junior, who said ``sometimes a wedding gift is simply a wedding gift,'' sometimes, Donald Trump, Jr., a wedding gift is a bribe from a foreign autocrat.
But what we know he was really buying is not to have a good time at a wedding but access to the Trump family.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Artificial Intelligence (Executive Session)
statements.title: Artificial Intelligence (Executive Session)
sentences: Madam President, on artificial intelligence, the warning signs about AI's rapid pace have never been clearer.

Today, I am calling for an all-Senators classified briefing with top administration officials to address the dangers of unchecked AI development and hold the administration accountable for its lack of action to protect the American people.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Introductory Statement on S. 5390
statements.title: Introductory Statement on S. 5390
sentences: This Act may be cited as the ``End Trump's Tariff Tax Act''.

REPEAL OF AUTHORITY TO IMPOSE DUTIES IN RESPONSE TO DISCRIMINATION BY FOREIGN COUNTRIES. (a) In General.--Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C. 1338) is repealed. (b) Conforming Amendment.--Section 337(m) of the Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C. 1337(m)) is amended by striking ``and sections 338 and 340''. (c) Effective Date; Termination of Duties.-- (1) Effective date.--The amendments made by this section shall take effect on August 1, 2026. (2) Termination of duties.--Any duties imposed under section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 before the date of the enactment of this Act shall have no force or effect on or after that date.

statements.title: U.S. Department of Justice (Executive Session)
sentences: Yesterday, Trump's DOJ forced a judge to throw out the charges against eight members of the radical extremist Oath Keepers, who were convicted of seditious conspiracy for plotting the January 6 insurrection--horrendous.
Trump already gave the insurrectionists clemency.
Now he is wiping their records clean, but there is no erasing what the Oath Keepers and the rest of the mob did at Trump's command on January 6.

Now, Trump has sent the country a clear message: There are no consequences for sedition, no punishment for attacking police, no repercussions for ransacking the Capitol to steal an election, so long as you do it in Trump's name.
Trump won't just give you clemency for committing a crime on his behalf; he will give you a reward.
There is still no legal guardrail stopping Trump and Blanche from giving payouts to January 6 insurrectionists at the taxpayers' expense.

statements.title: AGOA EXTENSION ACT--Motion to Proceed
sentences: Let's not forget that Blanche still hasn't released 3 million pages of the Epstein files.
After trying and failing to defund it altogether, Trump is putting the program to the torch by rolling back Federal standards that ensure Head Start will be high quality.
Donald Trump uses his office to help himself and his billionaire friends get ahead while holding back our children, while holding back our working families.
Senate Democrats have stood up for working Americans at every step, and we are going to continue to fight for the American people in the weeks and months ahead.
I will tell you this: If we had serious people leading the DOJ and serving as U.S. attorney, we never would have had these nonsense legal cases in the first place.

statements.title: Nomination of Todd Blanche (Executive Session)
sentences: And there is no guardrail preventing Trump and Blanche from using taxpayer dollars to give cash payouts to violent January 6 insurrectionists, MAGA billionaires, and the Trump family.

He said it ``would be a reimbursement for the pain that'' January 6 insurrectionists ``suffered.'' Where is the reimbursement for the economic pain Trump has inflicted on the American people with his rampant corruption and his disastrous agenda?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Introductory Statement on S. 5212
statements.title: Introductory Statement on S. 5212
sentences: The only thing Trump cares about in granting clemency is how much money you have and where do your loyalties lie.
Trump has wiped the slate clean for thousands of January 6 insurrectionists, Medicare fraudsters, white-collar criminals, and other crooks convicted of swindling the American people.
In Trump's America, if you have enough money or if you have the President's ear, then you are above the law.
Our legislation would also require anyone who receives a pardon to disclose financial gifts they made in connection with their clemency.
Congress has authority and responsibility to address corruption by clemency seekers and intermediaries, even if the conduct of the President may be beyond the reach of Federal criminal prosecution.
Financial disclosure reports by recipients of executive clemency.''.
Today, I am introducing legislation with Senators Blumenthal, Hirono, Cortez Masto, and Schiff to stop Trump from abusing his pardon power for personal gain.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Economy (Executive Session)
statements.title: Economy (Executive Session)
sentences: He keeps calling higher costs a ``hoax'' and affordability a ``made-up word.'' In the meantime, Trump has done nothing but make matters worse with his reckless and irresponsible war, with his chaotic tariffs, and with his crusade against American energy and assault on healthcare.
We are going to keep fighting to bring down Americans' costs and bring an end to Trump's failed agenda that is driving those costs up and up and up.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: War Powers Resolution (Executive Session)
statements.title: War Powers Resolution (Executive Session)
sentences: Finally, on the Iran WPR, as Trump plays keyboard warrior on Truth Social in his war with Iran, our men and women in uniform are risking their lives on the frontlines.
Trump said the war would last a week, but American servicemembers are still getting killed 5 months later, and the war seems to be expanding with Iran's latest attack in Egypt's territory.
Later today, Democrats will advance another War Powers Resolution so we can get our troops out of danger and end this war once and for all.
Will Senate Republicans keep helping Trump dig himself into a deeper and deeper hole in Iran or will they finally show some backbone, grab a shovel, and help Trump get out of this hole?
Vote for our War Powers Resolution to end this disaster.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motio
statements.title: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motion to Discharge
sentences: Nearly half a year into Trump's ruinous war with Iran, the conflict is widening instead of winding down.
The country is clamoring for you to end this war and to bring our troops home--something you can do right now by voting for Senator Gillibrand's War Powers Resolution.
Congress can break this vicious cycle of escalation Trump started in Iran, and this War Powers Resolution is how we do it.
Mr. President, I will be brief.
I urge--I plead--with my Republican colleagues to listen to the American people.
We are going to keep forcing Republicans to vote until you do.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Just look at some of these numbers: More than three in every four Americans say that Trump's disastrous war on Iran hasn't been worth the cost.

They should make Donald Trump hang his head in shame: 72 percent disapprove of how he is conducting the war in Iran; 79 percent disapprove of him on gas prices; 73 percent say you have the wrong priorities for them.
We are fighting for a bipartisan funding package--not partisan bills that bankroll Donald Trump's war agenda while leaving working families behind.
We must keep the government open without abandoning the needs of working families or giving Donald Trump a blank check for his destructive agenda.
Listen to this: Yesterday, Trump doubled prescription drug costs for millions of seniors by making cuts to Medicare drug plans.
Just 2 days before Medicare's 61st anniversary, no less, he is cutting the dollars we need and doubling prescription drug costs for millions of seniors.
A year ago, Trump ransacked over a trillion dollars from the healthcare system to bankroll tax giveaways to the wealthiest Americans and corporations.
Now he is coming after seniors--millions of them--by raising their prescription drug costs.
In Trump's America, families are fighting for their lives while the rich get richer.
Iran Mr. President, Trump is more concerned about protecting himself from the repercussions of his failed war in Iran than protecting our troops who are in the line of fire.
As Trump twiddles his thumbs without any plan for how to end his reckless misadventure, our servicemembers are facing down barrage after barrage of Iranian missiles and drones.
Democrats will soon force another vote on our War Powers Resolution to end this aimless war and bring our troops back home to their families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Sanctions (Executive Session)
statements.title: Sanctions (Executive Session)
sentences: The service honoring Lindsey Graham today was a tribute not only to our friend Lindsey but to his belief that America can act as a positive force on the global stage, especially in Ukraine.
Instead of standing strongly behind Ukraine and squarely against Vladimir Putin, Trump has tried and failed to pander to Russia.

At a time when Ukraine is turning the tide in the war against Putin, we must show the Ukrainians that our Congress and our country are fully behind them and show Putin that his war is a losing battle because the people of the United States and this Senate stand behind the Ukrainians.
That is how you make a bully like Putin listen, by putting real pressure on him to end this devastating war.
If Trump tries to abuse these tools and continue kowtowing to Putin, he will only make himself and our country look weaker.
Make no mistake, there is an overwhelming majority in this country that wants to see Russia defeated and Ukraine victorious in this fight against Putin's authoritarian invasion.
President Zelenskyy has reiterated that Ukraine is changing the tide in this war and gaining momentum every day.
Lindsey Graham spent his final days trying to help Ukraine achieve victory.
With this bill, we are going to show the Russians we mean business.
We are going to impose steep, mandatory sanctions to clamp down on the Russian war machine, drain the Kremlin's war chest, and truly cripple the Russian war effort.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Trump can brag about how Michiganders are forking over $4.23 for a gallon of gas on a car economy because of his failed war with Iran.
Trump can take credit for the massive tariff tax he is forcing Michiganders to pay because of the whopping 50 percent tariff he just slapped on Canada--the State's northern neighbor.
How stupid to impose a tariff when the two economies depend on each other.
SAVE America Act Madam President, on the SAVE Act, it is a new week in Washington, but one thing remains the same: The SAVE Act is dead on arrival in the Senate.
Trump knows he can't defend Republicans' abysmal record--his abysmal record-- so he whines to the GOP to pass the SAVE Act to disenfranchise voters who want to hold him accountable in November.
The SAVE Act ain't going to happen.
The courts have rejected the SAVE Act.
Congress rejected the SAVE Act.
Even members of Trump's own party have rejected the SAVE Act.
Republicans either need to drop this frivolous and vicious effort to pass the SAVE Act or watch Democrats stop it dead in its tracks.
In the coming days, I plan to announce new legislation to clean up the swamp Trump promised to drain a decade ago.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, the hole Donald Trump is digging himself into in Iran has turned into a crater.
Today, Democrats are going to force another vote on our War Powers Resolution to end this war; to get our troops out of harm's way; and to force Trump to face the reality of this catastrophe.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motio
statements.title: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motion to Discharge
sentences: Mr. President, Trump got America into this mess in Iran, and he has made it clear he is both unwilling and unable to get us out.

For the sake of our servicemembers, their families, working people from one end of the country to the other who are getting crushed by higher costs and gas prices, Senate Republicans need to join us and end Trump's war in Iran.
How many times will Democrats have to force a vote on our War Powers Resolution to bring our troops home before Senate Republicans join us?
Every time Republicans oppose our War Powers Resolution and vote against ending this war, they lose the faith of the American people.
We will keep forcing votes until Senate Republicans stop playing dumb and summon up the courage to do what is right.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Iran (Executive Session)
statements.title: Iran (Executive Session)
sentences: In a Truth Social post, yesterday, Trump seemed to brag that 18 servicemembers had been killed in his disastrous Iran war compared to the tens of thousands who died in Vietnam.
Asked about his handling of the Iran war, yesterday, Trump said: I think people are very impressed.
This week, Senate Democrats will force another vote on our War Powers Resolution to end this unauthorized war and get our troops out of harm's way.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Iran (Executive Calendar)
statements.title: Iran (Executive Calendar)
sentences: It is an absolute disgrace that Pete Hegseth has withheld casualty numbers in the Iran war from the American public.

One of the biggest questions Pete Hegseth has to answer today is why he was out marketing testosterone supplements for our troops last week while withholding casualty numbers from the Iran war to the American people.
We learned yesterday that the Pentagon failed to disclose that our troops have sustained nearly 100 injuries in the past few weeks of the Iran war.
Hegseth is hiding more than he is sharing these days--whether it is the number of wounded, the damage to our bases overseas, or the immense ballooning cost of this Iran war blunder.
I am calling on Pete Hegseth, Marco Rubio, and Donald Trump to tell the entire Congress everything they are telling the Republicans about the Iran war--both Chambers, both parties.
We will be forcing another vote this week on our War Powers Resolution to bring our troops home and end this war.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Corruption (Executive Session)
statements.title: Corruption (Executive Session)
sentences: Billionaires get another tax break.
Trump hands out pardons to the rich and well-connected, accepts lavish gifts from foreign governments, and arranges sweetheart deals for his family business.
It has a price, and working families are paying it every single day.

This time, the American people will see exactly how the scam works and exactly who has been handed the keys to the kingdom. iran Mr. President, on the Iran war, Donald Trump needs to reckon with the terrible cost of the disastrous war he has dared to call ``a skirmish,'' ``a little excursion.'' And once, he called it ``a lovely stay.'' There is nothing ``lovely'' or ``little'' about Trump's blunder in Iran--nothing.

On Thursday, Trump insisted to the Nation that we are ``winning big in Iran, and you will see the fruits of that labor very, very shortly.'' But instead and sadly, we saw three more brave American servicemembers tragically lose their lives over the weekend because of Trump's reckless war in Iran.
Dozens of other U.S. troops were wounded in Iranian strikes last week, and one servicemember remains missing.
This carnage is the bitter fruit of Trump's ``labor'' in Iran.
In the coming days, we are going to make Senate Republicans take another vote on our War Powers Resolution to end this war and get our troops out of harm's way.
Throughout the month, we will follow the money, expose the deals, name the people cashing in, and show how Trump's corruption reaches directly into the pockets of working people.
We will also be hosting another tabletop exercise with the Democrats' Elections Task Force to prepare to counter Trump's efforts to rig the 2026 midterms.
And the following week, we will release major legislation designed to rein in Trump's rampant corruption and to prevent any President from ever doing it again.
That is the pattern of this administration, and we will highlight it everywhere we see it.
We will follow the money and expose the deals.
We will show who profits, who pays, and how Trump has rigged the government for himself and the people closest to him.
And we will make one thing unmistakably clear: The White House is not for sale.

It has been my pleasure to work with them for several decades, and I know that under the leadership of their acting CEO and president Stacey Sikes--who once worked for me--we will continue our great tradition of delivering for Long Island together.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Election Security (Executive Session)
statements.title: Election Security (Executive Session)
sentences: We will fight like hell to make sure Trump can't silence voters.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Todd Blanche (Executive Session)
statements.title: Todd Blanche (Executive Session)
sentences: Do Senate Republicans have no issue with Blanche masterminding Trump's MAGA slush fund, arranging Trump's sweetheart deal from the IRS, and refusing to release 3 million pages of the Epstein file?
Republicans have set the bar so low for our Nation's top law enforcement official that you have to dig for it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT
statements.title: IMMIGRATION AND CUSTOMS ENFORCEMENT
sentences: Mr. President, how long will Republicans let Trump's secret police continue to sow chaos and violence in our American streets?
Both cases appear to have involved ICE agents who were not wearing body cameras--killing individuals who were not the subject of the agents' warrant.
There are no body cameras yet.
There are no body cameras as we would require.
If Republicans had passed our bill, there would be body cameras, proper agent ID, warrant requirements, and other commonsense reforms, and these killings might not have happened.
While every other police department in America has rules, our Republican colleagues and Trump said: No rules.
It is dangerous to give ICE agents free rein when we expect every other law enforcement agency in the country to follow basic codes of conduct.

Republicans who refuse to go along with real reforms of ICE--reforms that we see in every police department in the country--should pivot, change their minds, realize these shootings were just awful and work with us to reform this rogue Agency.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELECTION TASK FORCE
statements.title: ELECTION TASK FORCE
sentences: The whole reason Republicans are in their current mess is that Trump refuses to drop his radical SAVE Act--to strip millions of Americans of their voting rights.
Yesterday, Trump said Republicans have to get rid of the filibuster and pass the SAVE Act ``otherwise we're going to have a shutdown.'' That is what he said yesterday.
Unless Trump changes his course, realizes the SAVE Act cannot pass, and starts working on more productive things, we could be headed for another Trump shutdown.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Now, Mr. President, on Iran and the NDAA, when all the Trump administration can say about his disastrous war with Iran is that Vietnam was worse--a point Trump made yesterday--he reveals the scale of his failure.
Oh my God, a war that killed close to 50,000 Americans, a war that lasted almost a decade, a war that ripped America apart in ways that took decades to recover is what he compares Iran to?
The reason that we have war powers acts is to force an administration to think through the consequences of going to war ahead of time.
The NDAA cannot become a permission slip for that recklessness that we see occurring in Iran.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization (Executive Session)
statements.title: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization (Executive Session)
sentences: Mr. President, with their dreadful, horrific Dobbs decision 4 years ago today, six far-right wing MAGA Justices broke nearly 50 years of precedent to rip the right to choose away from millions--millions--of American women.
You can sum up both the dreadful Dobbs decision and the whole far- right philosophy the same way: less freedom in your life; more government interference in your personal decisions.
Dobbs will go down as one of the most damaging, legally dubious, and deeply out-of-touch Supreme Court decisions in American history.
It is a disgrace that the Supreme Court did it.
It is a disgrace on the Supreme Court itself.
Trump may not like talking about his crusade against women's reproductive rights, but he cannot hide from the pain he has inflicted on women across America.
Mr. President, 20 States--20--have enacted total or near-total abortion bans, which means that nearly 40 percent of women of reproductive age live in a State with an abortion ban.
The human cost of the Republican assault on women's reproductive freedom is sickening.
I have heard so many women share their stories of the horrors they have experienced in Trump's post-Roe America.
The GOP is treating mifepristone like it is poison and Planned Parenthood like it is an enemy of the State.
Even before the Justices behind Dobbs were confirmed, anyone could see they wanted to overturn Roe.
Every Republican Senator, who voted to confirm these radical Justices who stripped away these fundamental rights to choose that women have had for so long, will have to answer to the American people.
We will not--we Democrats--will not let Republicans brush their radical efforts to ban abortion under the rug.
The American people know it, and we are going to keep showing the difference between the two parties on this issue when the American people are strongly on our side.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, on Iran, with his failed and reckless war in Iran, Trump has turned ``the art of the deal'' into ``the art of the blunder.'' Donald Trump, Marco Rubio, and JD Vance are too afraid to come in front of the American people and the whole Senate to defend their war and so-called understanding, so now Trump will talk only to Senate Republicans behind closed doors.

Trump and Vance hadn't even finished their phony victory lap yesterday when Iran announced that it did not make any commitments to allow nuclear inspections--no commitments to allow nuclear inspections--even though that was supposed to be one of the mainstays of what Trump was pursuing.
In more than a week after announcing side deals and so-called understandings with Iran, the administration still hasn't briefed Congress or the American people on what has actually been agreed to.

Republicans can complain about Trump's war, his secrecy, and his disastrous deal with Iran all they want behind closed doors, but the only way to ensure this war ends once and for all is for Republicans to act.

Later today, Democrats will once again put Republicans on the record as to whether they want Trump's disastrous war to continue by forcing a vote on a House-passed Iran War Powers Resolution for the first time.
We have held nine other votes on our War Powers Resolutions to end the war, and Senate Republicans have left the American people disappointed each time.
Republicans need to support our War Powers Resolution to end the war, and they need to hold Trump's feet to the fire in their meeting tomorrow. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAVE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SAVE AMERICA ACT
sentences: Mr. President, on the SAVE database, yesterday's court decision bodes very poorly for the SAVE Act's survival.
The absolute last person Americans want combing through their personal data is Donald Trump.

Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and Russel Vought wanted to plug Americans' sensitive, personal information, including Social Security information, into their shoddy database and have DOGE's algorithm decide who gets to vote.
It is sci-fi voter suppression--authoritarianism by algorithm.
That is why Senate Democrats have blocked the SAVE Act--Trump's extreme anti- election legislation--over and over and over again.
Democrats will keep fighting Trump's plan to rig the rules in November because in our country, Americans decide elections, not algorithms installed by Musk, DOGE, and Trump. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DOBBS V. JACKSON WOMEN'S HEALTH ORGANIZATION
statements.title: DOBBS V. JACKSON WOMEN'S HEALTH ORGANIZATION
sentences: Finally, Mr. President, on our spotlight forum on the Dobbs decision, later today, we will join Senator Murray and other Senate Democrats for a spotlight forum on Republicans' extreme war on women's reproductive freedom ahead of the fourth anniversary of the Dobbs decision.
Donald Trump may want to brush his extreme effort to curtail women's reproductive rights under the rug, but we won't let him.

On the campaign trail in 2024, Donald Trump said that women ``won't be thinking about abortion'' if he got elected, but the truth is that they have to think about it more than ever before because of this awful decision.
Ever since the Dobbs decision 4 years ago, Republicans have been working around the clock to restrict access to abortion care.

So today, we are going to hear from people who have been forced to live with the consequences of Republicans' radical assault on women's reproductive freedom, and we will discuss how we are fighting back.
We are going to remind Donald Trump that women haven't stopped thinking about his efforts to take away their rights; they are mad as hell.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: H. CON. RES. 86
statements.title: H. CON. RES. 86
sentences: Madam President, for years, Trump promised to put maximum pressure on Iran, but he ended up delivering maximum confusion, maximum chaos, and maximum cost to the American people with his disastrous war.
And this is the 10th time Democrats have forced Republicans to vote on a War Powers Resolution to end the war.
The American people have paid the price for Trump's historic blunder in Iran.
And, meanwhile, Iran took Trump to the cleaners.
Trump gave Iran everything--their terrorist proxies, their control over the strait, their own revenue, their hundreds of billions of dollars in reconstruction aid.
But Democrats will keep forcing this vote--and we are going to keep doing it--because only Congress has the power to take this Nation to war, and this one must end.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Madam President, on Iran, Donald Trump's foreign policy by clown car continues to careen toward disaster.

After this failed war with Iran, Trump needs to rename ``The Art of the Deal'' as ``The Art of the Face Plant''--``The Art of the Face Plant.'' Just days after Trump boasted he had reopened the Strait of Hormuz, Iran announced it was closing the strait again.
Trump hasn't been able to guarantee safe passage through the strait yet, but he already has waived the sanctions to allow Iran to bring billions of dollars in oil revenue.
Iran gets what it wants; Trump dithers.
Now Trump and Vance are patting themselves on the back about getting Iran to agree to nuclear inspections that only stopped after Trump's 2025 strikes.
Trump's memo of understanding reads like an Iranian wish list.

After Trump's war, Iran gets to keep backing its terrorist proxies, to keep building ballistic missiles, to maintain a stranglehold on the global economy, and to rake in hundreds of billions of dollars in reconstruction aid and maritime tolls.
Trump got taken to the cleaners by Iran.
Two-thirds-- two-thirds--disapprove of how Trump has handled Iran.
The story of Trump's ruinous war has been the same since day one: The Iranian regime gets emboldened, the American people get screwed, and Donald Trump gets himself into a deeper and deeper hole.
Is it so vague that they told Iran one thing and will have to tell the world another?
As home ownership has gotten further and further out of reach for working families, so is the American dream.
The downpayment is excruciating to many and puts housing out of reach for them.
The legislation starts to streamline the zoning bottlenecks that have slowed down construction from one end of the country to the other.
ROAD to Housing also stops institutional investors from squeezing American families out of the housing market.

Democrats will continue to come up with innovative solutions to lower the cost of housing and all other necessities that working families need to achieve that American dream, which seems more out of reach than ever before because of this administration.

Trump is proudly holding America's national security hostage, demanding the passage of the SAVE Act--the worst anti-voting rights legislation he has ever dreamed up, and that is a high bar--and he wants it as ransom.
In attaching the SAVE Act to FISA, Trump is saying he won't make America secure unless we abandon our voting rights.
We will work with whomever it takes to end the affordability crisis.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, well, everyone who bought Trump's book ``The Art of the Deal'' ought to ask him for a refund because what Trump has done in Iran is the ``art of the disaster.'' The United States is worse off because of Trump's incompetence, his ego, his inability to listen to facts.
Iran took Trump to the cleaners with this so-called understanding.
Iran doesn't have to cut off support for its terrorist proxies.
Iran doesn't have to give up ballistic missile production.
Iran doesn't have to make any hard commitments on its nuclear program now, and there is no guarantee they make any in 60 days.

But Iran does get to rake in billions of dollars in oil sales, hundreds of billions in reconstruction aid, and God knows how much more in potential fees Trump may let it impose on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
Not to mention the benefits Iran will get from the sanction relief that Trump has promised with no idea of what he will get in return.
Again, Iran took Trump to the cleaners.

In Iran, ``the art of the deal'' has turned into the ``art of disaster.'' If Trump wants to send hundreds of billions of dollars to Iran, then he will need to do it with Republican votes because I will tell you, Democrats certainly won't be helping Trump send $300 billion to Iran.
Are my colleagues on the other side of the aisle prepared to send Iran $300 billion when economic needs are so severe here at home?
Now, back in 2015, Trump said that America's ``deal with Iran will go down as one of the most incompetent ever made.
We just don't win anymore!'' Trump is eating these words on a silver platter served up by Iran.
Again, in 2015 he said the ``deal with Iran will go down as one of the most incompetent ever.
We just don't win anymore!'' He is eating those words now because those apply so aptly to the deal that he just announced, so-called understanding, with Iran.
He is eating those words on a silver platter served up by Iran.
The Iranian regime is richer and more radical than before Trump's war.
Iran has greater control over the Strait of Hormuz than before the war began.
Trump's so-called understanding is the culmination and representation of his ruinous strategy in Iran since day one and his inability to govern in general.
In Iran and in so much else he does, Trump leads by whim, by ego, by greed.
In Iran, as in everything, the American people pay the price for Trump's incompetence.
And he is demanding to tie FISA to the extreme SAVE Act to attack Americans' voting rights.
The legislation starts to tackle the zoning and permitting bottlenecks that have slowed construction from one end of this country to the other.
Crucially, ROAD to Housing makes sure institutional investors don't squeeze American families out of buying a home.
Well, I will tell you right now, Trump needs to reveal any secret deals to Congress and the public immediately.
Here is what he said, this is Donald Trump: I will not approve FISA . . .

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (Executive Session)
statements.title: Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (Executive Session)
sentences: Trump also reasserted his demand to tie FISA to his radical SAVE Act, which would strip millions of Americans of their voting rights and resurrect the ghost of the Jim Crow south.
The SAVE Act is perhaps the most vicious piece of anti-voting rights legislation Trump has ever come up with and has absolutely nothing-- nothing--to do with FISA whatsoever.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, for months--for months--Senate Democrats and I have said that Trump's blunder of a war with Iran can't end soon enough.
It has been 2 days since Trump claimed he had reached an ``understanding'' with Iran, and he still hasn't released any details, an MOU--memo of understanding-- about what it actually is.

And third, and most importantly, I am calling on Trump to inform the American people on whatever his understanding with Iran involves, and he should do it immediately so we all know what the heck is going on.
Americans need to know what Trump has promised to Iran and what the United States will get out of it.

They need to know what is the deal on the Strait of Hormuz, which has caused gas prices to go through the roof, and we need to know what the projected end time is and what Iran will be doing with its nuclear capabilities.
Trump's Iranian misadventure has left America worse off than when he started it, worse off by every measure.
The Iranian regime is more extreme than before Trump launched this disastrous war.
Iran has more control over the Strait of Hormuz than before Trump's disastrous war.
Democrats will soon force a vote on a War Powers Resolution to end Trump's war because every minute this blunder goes on is a minute too long.
So I am asking three things: First, I am calling on Donald Trump to hold a classified Gang of 8 meeting to disclose this so-called MOU, this memo of understanding.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHILDCARE
statements.title: CHILDCARE
sentences: Mr. President, today Senators Murray, Warren, and I are releasing the most comprehensive Senate report to date on Trump's broken promise to make childcare more affordable.
It's not possible for us to take care of day care, Medicare, Medicaid, all these individual things.

Trump thinks it is fine to stick working Americans with the bill for his gilded ballroom, his costly war in Iran, $2 billion of slush fund payouts for him and his MAGA loyalists, and trillions of dollars of tax cuts for the wealthy, but helping families afford childcare is just too much?
Trump isn't just refusing to lower costs of childcare; he is actively making it more expensive and harder for families to find, and they are desperate for it.

Trump has removed caps on childcare costs, frozen $2.4 billion in childcare funding for five States that didn't vote for him, and made numerous other changes that have driven up the cost of childcare.
Is it any wonder families paying 5 percent more for childcare now than before Trump took office in 2025 are angry?

When I was majority leader and Democrats were in charge, we made a historic $39 billion investment in childcare that lowered childcare costs by 10 percent, added 63,000 new childcare workers, and increased the supply of available childcare slots by 7 percent.
America, that is what Democrats did when we had the majority; we helped people with childcare.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
statements.title: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
sentences: Senate Republicans have already refused to outlaw the fund, and now they will have to show the country whom they stand for once again: American taxpayers or Donald Trump; working families or cop-beating insurrectionists.
That is why I will force Republicans to answer for Trump's slush fund and IRS sweetheart deal today.
I am going to force the Republicans to answer for this Trump slush fund and the IRS sweetheart deal by asking to ban it by law on the floor.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 21ST CENTURY ROAD TO HOUSING ACT
statements.title: 21ST CENTURY ROAD TO HOUSING ACT
sentences: Lowering housing costs is absolutely essential to ending the affordability crisis plaguing working families across the country.
The bipartisan package includes, as I said, many bills led by Senate Democrats over the years to expand housing supply and lower costs.
The bill tackles local zoning and permitting that have kept housing supply from growing.
This bill makes sure people are not squeezed out of the market of buying a home by institutional investors.
We need to make a priority downpayment assistance, reducing mortgage insurance costs, and doing even more to expand housing supply as well as to lower costs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STATEMENTS ON INTRODUCED BILLS AND JOINT RESOLUTIONS
statements.title: STATEMENTS ON INTRODUCED BILLS AND JOINT RESOLUTIONS
sentences: This Act may be cited as the ``Stock Buyback Accountability Act of 2026''.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Introductory Statement on S. 4796
statements.title: Introductory Statement on S. 4796
sentences: This Act may be cited as the ``Stock Buyback Accountability Act of 2026''.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Madam President, Senate Democrats have been unwavering in calling for an immediate end to Trump's war with Iran, and we will continue to do so until his blunder is well and truly over.
For more than 100 days, I have come to this floor to denounce Trump's reckless and dangerous Iran war and demand its end.
Now, it has been nearly 24 hours since Trump announced there was a potential deal with Iran, and we still don't know the details.
But Trump hasn't even revealed the text of his ``understanding'' with Iran.
Trump must brief Congress and the public on the details of his understanding with Iran immediately and end this war once and for all.
There are still many unknowns about Trump's negotiations with Iran, but we know this for certain: We are worse off than before Trump began this foolish war of choice.
The Iranian regime is more radical than before Trump began his war.
Iran has more control over the Strait of Hormuz today than before the war began.
Americans are scratching their heads wondering what we have accomplished in Iran.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FISA
statements.title: FISA
sentences: Madam President, now on Pulte and FISA and the SAVE Act, Senate Democrats have made it clear that however long Trump wants Bill Pulte to serve as Acting Director of National Intelligence is too long.
Trump's absurd demand to tie his radical SAVE Act--restricting Americans' voting rights--to FISA is also deeply reckless and demonstrates his true motives.
The SAVE Act is perhaps the most vicious piece of anti-voting rights legislation Trump has ever come up with and it will not pass and it will not save FISA, Donald Trump.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NOMINATION OF JUSTIN D. SMITH
statements.title: NOMINATION OF JUSTIN D. SMITH
sentences: Smith also helped prepare Trump's lead counsel for the Supreme Court case to grant the President absolute immunity to break the law.

A longtime Republican operative, Smith once wrote in 2007 that ``abortion is murder, gay marriage is a sin . . . and on these principles of our party, there must be no equivocation.'' In keeping with Trump's efforts to undermine America's elections, Smith also supported efforts to challenge the results of the 2020 election.
I strongly urge a ``no'' vote from my colleagues.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Introductory Statement on S. 4781
statements.title: Introductory Statement on S. 4781
sentences: Mr. President, the Make More in America Act--if we have learned anything from the past few years, it is that the American people will pay the price when wars, pandemics, and other shocks disrupt America's supply chains.

Today, I led Senate Democrats in introducing the Make More in America Act, which will invest in American manufacturing to create jobs, lower costs, strengthen our national security, and build a more resilient economy.
The Make More in America Act is going to help us face the challenges that China and other countries present, and we should move it as quickly as we can.

From COVID-19 to Trump's disastrous war with Iran, to China weaponizing our reliance on them for certain products, America cannot afford to depend on the unreliable when the security and prosperity of our people are at stake.

Our bill would rebuild American manufacturing, strengthen our supply chains to lower costs, and give us an edge over the Chinese Communist Party, all of which--all of which--should be bipartisan priorities.
SHORT TITLE; TABLE OF CONTENTS. (a) Short Title.--This Act may be cited as the ``Make More in America Act of 2026''. (b) Table of Contents.--The table of contents for this Act is as follows: Sec. 1.

Many of those markets are, or could be, vital export opportunities with meaningful economic, national security, and job creation implications for the United States. (5) The United States also faces supply chain vulnerabilities in critical inputs for those industries of the future, including energy, semiconductors and associated technologies like circuit boards, critical minerals, batteries, and other technology components. (6) Capital-intensive industries with long production cycles, such as shipbuilding, chemical processing, and nuclear energy systems, face particularly acute financing challenges during the commercialization phase and the scaling of domestic production.

Section 2(l)(1) of the Export-Import Bank Act of 1945 (12 U.S.C. 635(l)(1)) is amended-- (1) in the matter preceding subparagraph (A), by striking ``or by a covered country'' and inserting ``, the Russian Federation, or a covered country''; (2) in subparagraph (A), by striking ``or by a covered country'' and inserting ``, the Russian Federation, or a covered country''; and (3) in subparagraph (B)-- (A) in clause (v), by striking ``computing'' and inserting ``technologies''; and (B) in clause (vi), by inserting ``nuclear energy,'' after ``Renewable energy,''.
