statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INFLATION
statements.title: INFLATION
sentences: That is when inflation hit a record high, long-time high of 4.2 percent.
Trump has torched the American economy with his tariffs, with his disastrous war in Iran, and with his unprecedented cuts to healthcare and other vital services.

As Americans live through a financial nightmare, Donald Trump is living out his billionaire dreams: golden ballrooms, lavish gifts from foreign countries, sweetheart deals for his family business, taxpayer- funded cash payouts for him and his cronies through the slush fund.
Well, we will see how much Trump and the GOP love inflation come November. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, on Iran, for weeks, Donald Trump, Pete Hegseth, and Marco Rubio have insisted their disastrous war in Iran is over.

It doesn't take a military genius to see that Trump's fiasco of a war with Iran never ended, not with American helicopters being shot down, not when American bases are being attacked and American troops are coming under fire.
The only thing more absurd than the Trump administration's lies about the Iran war is that Republicans accept them at face value and just go along--too many, too many of them.
For months, Democrats have urged Republicans to support our War Powers Resolution to end this war for real.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOCK BUYBACK ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2026
statements.title: STOCK BUYBACK ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. President, on stock buybacks, you know costs are skyrocketing, but corporations are making massive profits.
I am introducing legislation today with Senators Wyden and Warren to rein in the stock buybacks that corporate executives use to line their own pockets to the detriment of the American people.
Americans need more jobs and higher wages right now, not more privileges for millionaires and billionaires.

Our bill would quadruple the tax big corporations pay on these stock buybacks, which will both push companies to invest in their workers in the future and allow us to invest more in lowering costs and helping working families get ahead, with some of the money we could use when you collect that 4 percent on stock buybacks.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Economy (Executive Session)
statements.title: Economy (Executive Session)
sentences: Trumpflation hit 4.2 percent last month, a 3-year high.
Another month of Trump's illegal Iran war, another month of Trump's tariffs, another month of Republican control of Congress, and what does America get?

Republicans are driving up costs with their expensive tariff tax, with their disastrous war with Iran that is leading to recordbreaking gas prices, with their trillion-dollar cut to healthcare, and with the rest of this radical, hard-right agenda that so misserves the American people.
Trump's tariffs are costing American families more than $1,700 a year on average.
American families have had to pay an additional $750 on average during these past few months just to meet skyrocketing costs of gasoline because of the Iran war.
Republicans continue to fight for Trump and his corruption rather than lower costs for working families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Iran (Executive Session)
statements.title: Iran (Executive Session)
sentences: Senate Republicans need to step up, advance our War Powers Resolution to end the war, and bring our troops home.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
statements.title: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
sentences: Asked whether he would stop trying to give cash payouts to his corrupt cronies, convicted criminals, and January 6 insurrectionists, Trump said: If it was up to me, I'd pay them the kind of money that they deserve.

The only thing January 6 insurrectionists deserve for maiming police officers is to sit in a prison cell, but Donald Trump and Senate Republicans think the rioters deserve a cut of Americans' paychecks.
Republicans could have voted for our amendment to prevent taxpayer-funded payouts to violent January 6 rioters.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Trump launched his disastrous war with Iran without a clear objective, without a coherent strategy, and without a care for how it would endanger our brave servicemembers and hurt the American people.

Soon, Senate Democrats will force another vote on a War Powers Resolution to end the war--the ninth opportunity we have given Republicans to do their jobs and dig themselves and Trump out of this hole.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECOGNITION OF THE MAJORITY LEADER
statements.title: RECOGNITION OF THE MAJORITY LEADER
sentences: Trump loves giving Americans' taxpayer dollars to his billionaire friends.

Trump thinks forcing Americans to fork over their paychecks to line the pockets of his corrupt friends is ``so important.'' Trump says ripping Americans off to give kickbacks to convicted criminals who beat police officers to death on January 6 is a beautiful thing--that is what he said.

Amendment after amendment, vote after vote, Republicans are going to have to answer to the American people on tariffs, on skyrocketing costs, on the disastrous war with Iran, on the violence Trump's masked agents have unleashed on our streets.
Will Republicans vote for more affordable housing?
Will Republicans require Trump's masked agents to wear body cameras?

Apparently, Republicans think we cannot afford a single penny to help Americans cover the skyrocketing costs of gasoline, of healthcare, of housing, of food, of energy--you name it--but somehow we can afford to give another $70 billion to Trump's rogue Agencies even though ICE and Border Patrol already have $100 billion cash on hand.

When you pull up to the gas pump, and it is $4.50, or even higher in many places, ask yourself: Why don't Republicans vote to lower those prices instead of giving ICE and Border Patrol, already discredited, more money when they have $100 billion sitting there?
Let's take stock of what we could buy with the $170 billion Trump's personal police force would have at its disposal if this bill passed.

Instead of dragging law-abiding parents and children into unmarked vehicles, that $170 billion could fund food stamps for nearly 2 years or Head Start for 14 years or childcare assistance for two decades-- things America wants.
Blanche has blocked the release of more than half the Epstein files, withholding 3 million--3 million--pages from the public.
Maybe Epstein's friend Donald Trump could tell us why Blanche went to such lengths to cover up the files.
Blanche also lied to Congress under oath when he claimed he had met with the Epstein survivors--something they said never happened.

Trump won't give Americans a penny to help offset the skyrocketing costs he brought on our country, but he is more than happy to charge them nearly $2 billion to line the pockets of his family, his billionaire friends, and the criminals who mauled police officers on January 6.

Think about it: Because Republicans refused to support our amendment, the only thing standing between Donald Trump and $2 billion in American taxpayer money to enrich himself, his billionaire cronies, and his cop- beating insurrectionists is a promise from Todd Blanche that could evaporate in a minute.
I urge Republicans to vote like the American people are watching-- because they are.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PARTY PRIORITIES
statements.title: PARTY PRIORITIES
sentences: Mr. President, this week, with the contrast between the two parties in bright lights, Republicans are consumed by Donald Trump's priorities: his corrupt slush fund, his gilded ballroom, his rogue police force, his reckless war with Iran, and his refusal to contain the rising costs Americans face every week.
And we will keep driving that contrast every day, on every issue. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
statements.title: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
sentences: Just weeks ago, Blanche lied under oath to Congress claiming that he met with Epstein survivors.
The Epstein survivors themselves said that was a lie.
Trump promised never to cut Medicaid and broke it.
Trump promised to release the Epstein files and broke it.

It is only a matter of time before Blanche and Trump go back on their word and resume their efforts to put your tax dollars in the pockets of MAGA billionaires, violent criminals, and, of course, the Trump family.

No matter what, from the start, I will personally push to permanently ban both the slush fund and the blank check Trump cut to himself and his family that would allow them to cheat on their taxes when this Republican reconciliation bill comes to the floor.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELECTION TASK FORCE
statements.title: ELECTION TASK FORCE
sentences: The Senators and a first-rate team of election experts on our task force will simulate different scenarios, including interference operations from a foreign adversary, Trump's deployment of Federal agents to polling places, and law enforcement agents seizing ballots from local election officials.

Instead of changing his disastrous and deeply unpopular policies, Trump has pledged to deploy ``an Election Integrity Army in every single State.'' But in Trump's eyes, he believes that an election only has integrity if he wins it, and he doesn't care if he cheats to do it.
We will be ready, and we will preserve the integrity of American elections--something so sacred for 250 years.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECONCILIATION
statements.title: RECONCILIATION
sentences: The American people don't need to see the bill text to know that Republicans are fighting for Donald Trump, not for working families.
Republicans will have to vote on tariffs.
Republicans will have to vote on Trump's disastrous war with Iran.
Republicans will have to vote on ICE and Border Patrol's abuses of power.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: C-SPAN2
statements.title: C-SPAN2
sentences: His fiascos in foreign policy, most recently in Iran, show he doesn't listen to facts or intelligence.

Trump's Department of Justice put out a statement saying that it would abide by the recent court order that temporarily blocked Trump from using Americans' tax dollars to pay off his MAGA loyalists and billionaire friends and violent insurrectionists who maimed our Capitol Police on January 6.

Trump and his family still get to cheat their way out of paying their taxes and then use your tax dollars to line their pockets and give handouts to his billionaire cronies, criminals, and cop-killing insurrectionists?

Senate Testimony Mr. President, on Rubio coming to the Hill, Secretary Rubio has a lot to answer for when he testifies before the Senate today--on China, on giving kickbacks to Russia, on Ukraine, on withholding arms to Taiwan, on this administration's ridiculous rhetoric on NATO, on the disastrous gutting of foreign aid that is leaving Americans vulnerable to one infectious disease after another, on Iran, on foreign corruption.

And today, with all these questions, all these bungles, all these terrible--terrible--missteps that hurt America--today will be the first time Marco Rubio, the National Security Advisor and Secretary of State, testifies before the American people since the start of Trump's disastrous war with Iran--first time.
Yesterday, Trump said he finds the peace negotiations with Iran ``very boring.'' And that he ``couldn't care less'' if they are over.
We are going to kill this slush fund permanently, and we are going to bury it and bury it deep.

I urge my colleagues as well to ask Rubio to address recent reports that the Trump administration left a loophole open for the past year and a half that allowed China to acquire, potentially, hundreds of thousands of cutting-edge American AI chips.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
statements.title: ANTI-WEAPONIZATION FUND
sentences: At a time when Americans can barely afford to fill their tanks, to keep the lights on, put food on their table, Trump wants the American people to pay for handouts for MAGA billionaires, cop-beating January 6 insurrectionists, and his own family.
If Republicans try to meddle with the appropriations process to do Trump's bidding, we will fight it there too.
And if Republicans try to use toothless constraints to make the slush fund more palatable, we will press them to dismantle it entirely.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, on the Iran war, once again the ongoing fighting in Iran has blown holes in Trump's claim that victory is at hand.
Over the weekend, Trump said he is ``in no hurry to end the war in Iran.'' No hurry?
Democrats and a handful of Republicans came together before Memorial Day to advance a War Powers Resolution to withdraw our troops from hostility with Iran.
I will tell you who is in a hurry for this blunder to end: the American people who are getting crushed by record gas prices at the pump.
We will not stop forcing votes to end this war until this disastrous war is over once and for all.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ECONOMY
statements.title: ECONOMY
sentences: None of that lowers costs; none of that helps working families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECONCILIATION
statements.title: RECONCILIATION
sentences: And they should also be with us when we want to end the chaos--the chaos on the streets of our cities--by having ICE and Border Patrol have reasonable guardrails so they don't kill Americans on the streets.
His Iran war is one of the most chaotic foreign misadventures America has ever gone on, and it gets worse all the time, as gas prices go above $4.50.
The American people don't need to see the bill text to know where Senate Republicans stand: with Donald Trump, right now, not working families.
Were it not for Democrats fighting this ballroom every step of the way, Republicans would have wasted a billion taxpayer dollars for Trump's palace in a heartbeat.

It is absurd to ask Americans, who are struggling to make ends meet, to shell out another $70 billion to ICE and Border Patrol when these rogue Agencies are sitting on $100 billion from the Big Beautiful Bill.

But the costs of this war, which the American people are opposed to, and the costs of many other things might have to be funded out of this in the next few months, and so they don't want to take the money for ICE or for Border Patrol when there is $100 billion sitting there.
In this bill, Trump can never be prosecuted, investigated for tax fraud, even though I and so many others wouldn't trust him with his tax returns for a minute.
Trump doesn't have to pay his taxes, but he is more than happy to put your tax dollars in the pockets of his cronies, criminals, and cop- killing January 6 insurrectionists.
Republicans want to spend tens of billions of American tax dollars, but we still don't know what exactly we are voting on in mere hours.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COST OF LIVING
statements.title: COST OF LIVING
sentences: And the price of gasoline is up 42 percent compared to this time last year, thanks to Trump's disastrous war with Iran.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
sentences: Trump's slush fund is a heist where the robber owns the bank, runs the police department, and gets to pardon himself on the way out.
Just as egregious as how Trump stole this money is who he plans to give it to: his billionaire cronies, convicted criminals, and the cop beaters who maimed our brave U.S. Capitol Police on January 6.

We will make sure Republicans have to go on the record and show what they are really fighting for when we vote this week: Trump's gilded palace--not working families, not lower costs, not for the American people.
No matter what happens, we will make sure the American people know where Republicans stand.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Trump Administration (Executive Session)
statements.title: Trump Administration (Executive Session)
sentences: This week, Trump showed us again exactly what his Presidency is about: not helping Americans, not lowering costs, not making life easier for working families; but finding new ways to turn taxpayer dollars into political payouts, personal perks, and vanity projects.
Trump settled with himself in his own lawsuit against his own government to funnel taxpayer money to his political allies, January 6 insurrectionists, and far-right loyalists.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motio
statements.title: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motion to Discharge
sentences: Trump and his band of MAGA loyalists have jumped at every opportunity to intimidate election officials, to attack vote-by-mail, to seize voter data, and to undermine our elections in any way they can.
In Congress, Trump's MAGA majorities keep pushing the SAVE Act, which we know would disenfranchise tens--tens--of millions of voters.

With the SAVE Act, Republicans would purge millions of American citizens from the voter rolls through a screening algorithm designed by none other than the trio--the evil trio--of Trump, Vought, Musk, and their DOGE squad.
The radical rightwing majority on the Supreme Court has aided Trump's assault on our democracy every step of the way.

We are going to bring together lawyers and observers, rapid-response teams, cyber security experts, State and local officials, and the most renowned election experts in the country to protect our democracy before, during, and after this election.
We are going to fight like hell to make sure our elections belong to the voters--not to Donald Trump.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WAR POWERS RESOLUTION
statements.title: WAR POWERS RESOLUTION
sentences: Mr. President, well, earlier today, Trump said he was just an hour away from launching another wave of attacks on Iran before he changed his mind.
Trump says: ``We may have to give Iran another big hit''--that ``we're all set to start'' bombing at a moment's notice.
If there was ever a time to support our War Powers Resolution to withdraw troops from hostilities with Iran, it is now.
We have long since passed the War Powers Act's 60-day threshold to end hostilities that many of our colleagues cited as the time their position on this war would finally change.
Why do Republicans pretend Trump's war ended after 60 days, when it clearly has continued, with U.S. and Iranian forces exchanging fire in the Strait of Hormuz?
It is obvious even to a layman that the greatest vulnerability we faced, if we challenged Iran, was the Strait of Hormuz.

Americans took note all seven times this Republican majority passed up the opportunity to support our War Powers Resolution to end this disaster, and they will take note of those Republicans who pass up the eighth time--the eighth opportunity--to stop this war, which will occur shortly when we vote.
Every week this war continues and Republicans continue to sit in silence, Democrats will force a vote on the War Powers Resolution and make Republicans go on record with their support for this war.
I urge my colleagues to vote yes.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Department of Justice (Executive Session)
statements.title: Department of Justice (Executive Session)
sentences: As working families shorten their grocery lists, as they struggle to make ends meet, Donald Trump has added a nearly $2 billion slush fund for his MAGA allies and January 6 insurrectionists to his wish list of pet projects he wants to fund with taxpayer dollars.
Again, America, he sued America for $10 billion, and then he settled with himself and said: OK, I will settle for $2 billion, and then I can use that to aid my cronies.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXECUTIVE RESOLUTIONS
statements.title: EXECUTIVE RESOLUTIONS
sentences: Calendar Number 624: Frank Weiland, of the District of Columbia, to be an Assistant Secretary of State (International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs).

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ECONOMY
statements.title: ECONOMY
sentences: Just this week, The Economist said: ``America faces another grocery- price shock.'' CNN: ``America is in for yet another long spell of price pain.'' PBS News: ``Iran war hits home as gasoline prices fuel significant U.S. inflation jump.'' Trump will surely try to brush aside these reports of higher costs as ``fake news,'' but Americans don't need to see the headlines to know we are in an affordability crisis.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHINA
statements.title: CHINA
sentences: He arrived with a posse of billionaires in tow, including his own son, who oversees the family business.

That would get in the way of Donald Trump and his family profiting off of doing business with the Chinese Communist Party--just hours in, and Xi Jinping has already threatened to ``collide or even clash'' with the United States if we continue our support for Taiwan.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, on Iran, every day the costs of Trump's disastrous handling of his illegal war with Iran mount up.
We owe a tremendous debt of gratitude to them, their families, and their brothers and sisters in arms who remain in harm's way.
The war with Iran has cost American families financially, causing inflation to spiral out of control, gas prices to skyrocket, grocery costs to climb.
Americans have paid dearly for Trump's blunder in Iran in exchange for little or no gain.
Vladimir Putin couldn't be happier with the Iran war, as Russia rakes in record profits from its energy exports, and the Americans use up munitions that could go to Ukraine.
According to press reports, the Chinese have planned secret arms sales to Iran and now look to Taiwan with greater eagerness, since America has devoted so many of our military resources to Iran.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANNIVERSARY OF BUFFALO, NEW YORK, SHOOTING
statements.title: ANNIVERSARY OF BUFFALO, NEW YORK, SHOOTING
sentences: The families of the victims and the whole community pushed Congress to come together in a way it hadn't for decades, beating back the dark forces of the NRA and passing the first major gun safety bill in more than a quarter century.
I worked hand in hand with the families of those we lost in Buffalo to pass the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, and their work has undoubtedly saved many lives.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Iran Mr. President, on Iran, Trump was talking about his disastrous Iran war when he said: I don't think about Americans' financial situations.

If Senate Republicans care about Americans' financial situations, which they should, they need to vote for our War Powers Resolution today to limit Trump's ability to continue this war without authorization.
Senator Merkley will be introducing that War Powers Resolution, which I am proud to cosponsor, in a little while.

Today's vote will be the Republicans' seventh--seventh--opportunity to support our resolution to withdraw our troops from hostilities with Iran and stop the economic fallout from this historic blunder.
Donald Trump could sell out American autoworkers by allowing Chinese EVs to flood our markets and crowd out domestic manufacturing.

Donald Trump could sell out America on chips and AI, allowing the sale of our AI chips and semiconductor equipment to China so they can catch up in the technology race that will define the global economy for the next decade.

Donald Trump could sell out on fentanyl, failing to use American leverage to extract real and meaningful concessions from the Chinese Communist Party to prevent the deadly flow of fentanyl poisoning our communities.
Donald Trump could sell out Taiwan, whose people want to continue living in freedom, instead of under the jackboot of the Chinese Communist Party.
It is also a threat to the global economy, given how many semiconductor chips are made in Taiwan.

The CFPB, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, has played a critical role on the side of people to help them avoid junk fees, predatory medical debt, and payday lenders who take advantage of people in need, including military servicemembers.
I urge Senate Republicans to join Democrats in protecting the Fed and restoring some stability to our economy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL UNDER CHAPTER 8 OF TITLE 5, UNITED STATES CODE, OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION RELATIN
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL UNDER CHAPTER 8 OF TITLE 5, UNITED STATES CODE, OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION RELATING TO THE WITHDRAWAL OF THE RULE...
sentences: Mr. President, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau--CFPB--has played a critical role on the side of people to help them avoid junk fees, predatory medical debt, payday lenders who take advantage of people in need, including so many of our military servicemembers.
We must stop it, and I urge a yes vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Inflation (Executive Calendar)
statements.title: Inflation (Executive Calendar)
sentences: Inflation rose to 3.8 percent in April because of Donald Trump's costly tariffs, his disastrous war with Iran, and failed economic agenda.
And, again, it is all because of Trump's tariffs, his war with Iran, his failed economic agenda.
Ask Americans how many people want to see a billion dollars for a ballroom and no money to help reduce the cost of food, the cost of electricity, the cost of housing, the cost of childcare.
When will they realize that Americans want lower costs, not a gold-plated ballroom for our billionaire President.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BUDGET RECONCILIATION
statements.title: BUDGET RECONCILIATION
sentences: The Republican bill would pump tens of billions of dollars into ICE and Border Patrol without any guardrails to prevent these rogue Agencies from continuing to unleash violence on American streets.
We will force Republicans to take vote after vote, showing that instead of helping working families, Republicans are forcing Americans to pay for Trump's billionaire ballroom.
We will bring challenges under the Byrd rule.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HANTAVIRUS
statements.title: HANTAVIRUS
sentences: I put out a plan that calls on the Trump administration to rehire these fired outbreak-response experts, to restore funding to protect Americans from infectious diseases, and to rejoin the World Health Organization and other groups that track outbreaks and provide early warning.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: On Iran, Donald Trump and members of his administration have referred to the fighting in Iran as a ``skirmish,'' a ``mini- war'', a ``little excursion,'' a ``blip'' and most recently ``a love tap.'' Let's call the ongoing hostilities with Iran for what they are-- a war.
It has been over a week since we hit the 60-day threshold under the War Powers Act, which means the hostilities must cease unless Trump gets authorization from Congress.
Tell that to the American servicemembers who were dodging Iranian drones and missiles in the Strait of Hormuz last week.
Just today, the most recent round of negotiations with Iran fell apart.
It is time to do something about it, so Democrats are forcing a seventh vote on our War Powers Resolution this week to withdraw United States troops from hostilities with Iran.
If Republicans care about preserving our War Powers, keeping our servicemembers safe, lowering Americans' costs, they need to support the War Powers Resolution and end this war.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Inflation (Executive Session)
statements.title: Inflation (Executive Session)
sentences: The historic blunder in Iran is compounding the increase in prices.
Prices were going up for childcare.
Prices were going up because of tariffs--and then the war.
Our greatest challenge in Iran is Donald Trump and Secretary Hegseth, and Americans know it.

Are you going to take out a brass band and salute that inflation is up 3.5 percent? salute that the Strait of Hormuz is still closed? salute that we still haven't found the nuclear facilities and potential weaponry that Iran has?
It is past time that Senate Republicans joined Democrats on our War Powers Resolution.
Tomorrow marks 60 days since Donald Trump officially notified Congress about his attack on Iran.
After we cross that 60-day threshold, there can be no more doubt that he is violating the War Powers Act.
Support our War Powers Resolution.
We have forced votes on our resolutions five times and we are going to force it a sixth time today and it is going to come back week after week.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMENDING RULE XXXVII OF THE STANDING RULES OF THE SENATE TO PROHIBIT SENATORS FROM TRADING ON PREDICTION MARKETS
statements.title: AMENDING RULE XXXVII OF THE STANDING RULES OF THE SENATE TO PROHIBIT SENATORS FROM TRADING ON PREDICTION MARKETS
sentences: When we come back in May, I will work with my colleagues to ensure that the administration can't get rich off betting markets.

But today's resolution is a very good first step, and I thank my colleague the Senator from Ohio and my colleagues on both sides of the aisle for working quickly to approve this legislation, which I am proud to support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motio
statements.title: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motion to Discharge
sentences: This sixth vote on the Democrats' War Powers Act is different than the first five.
The 60-day threshold for war powers is upon us.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: U.S. SUPREME COURT
statements.title: U.S. SUPREME COURT
sentences: Mr. President, earlier this morning, the conservative majority on the Supreme Court took another step toward resurrecting the Jim Crow South.
Shame on the MAGA Justices for rigging our elections.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ELECTION TASK FORCE
statements.title: ELECTION TASK FORCE
sentences: Trump continues to push for his SAVE Act to disenfranchise tens of millions of Americans, and he stacked his administration with election deniers.
Online radicals are threatening poll workers and are spreading lies about voter fraud.
And, here in Congress, hard- right Republicans are trying to pass Jim Crow 2.0 in the SAVE Act.

This afternoon, a group of Senators and I will meet with former Attorney General Eric Holder, Mark Elias, and some of the country's top election experts to talk about how we can be ready for any and all threats that might come against our elections this fall.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY
sentences: A year of childcare for 30,000 families; skills for training 50,000 new electricians, plumbers, and welders; disaster loans for 10,000 households; and so much more.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Finally, Mr. President, on Iran and gas prices--as I said, there is a lot going on--just hours ago, Pentagon officials told Congress that Trump's disastrous war has cost taxpayers $25 billion.
Let me repeat: U.S. gas prices are at their highest level since the beginning of the war in Iran.
It is now $4.23--up 40 percent since Trump started his costly war with Iran.
Trump says he is bleeding Iran economically.
The Iranian regime is still radical.
This morning, Trump warned that Iran better get smart soon.
This week, Democrats will force a vote on our War Powers Resolution for the sixth time.
Under the War Powers Act, Trump must seek authorization for his war to continue beyond 60 days.
How many War Powers Resolutions do Democrats need to put before Senate Republicans until they do what is right?
We will continue to force votes every week as this war rages on.
I urge my Republican friends to help bail Donald Trump out of his mess.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
statements.title: TRUMP ADMINISTRATION
sentences: Mr. President, as our Nation wages Donald Trump's reckless war with a dangerous and erratic enemy and as the Department of Homeland Security is still not funded because of the high jinks within the President's own party, Donald Trump has decided to focus on a taxpayer- funded, gold-plated ballroom instead of focusing on these important national security issues: the war in Iran--dangerous for the United States; the fact that we haven't funded Homeland Security--dangerous for the United States.
Democrats chose to fund national security and keep Americans safe.
Apparently, Donald Trump wasn't satisfied with forcing Americans to foot the bill for a war they do not want and $1 trillion in tax cuts for millionaires and billionaires that Americans eschew.

What happened to funding the ballroom with tens of millions of dollars in shady donations Trump received from billionaires and corporations or with the billions his family has made off the Presidency?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JOINT MEETING OF CONGRESS
statements.title: JOINT MEETING OF CONGRESS
sentences: Today, the visit of King Charles III should serve as a reminder to the President of the United States and to every elected official in this country: Friends and allies matter, and most of all, for the security of Europe, NATO matters.
I encourage His Majesty to impress upon the President the absolute importance of NATO.
To walk away from NATO would be a terrible mistake that will reverberate for generations and make Americans far less safe.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CUBA
statements.title: CUBA
sentences: Now, Mr. President, on Cuba, since launching his disastrous war with Iran, Donald Trump has said that ``Cuba's going to be next'' and that ``we may stop by Cuba'' after we are finished.
Republicans must get out in front of the looming catastrophe in Cuba before it gets even worse, as they should have done with Trump's war in Iran.
Today, Senate Democrats will advance a War Powers Resolution to give Republicans an opportunity to stop a looming catastrophe in Cuba.
Republicans, do Trump a favor: Support our War Powers Resolution so he doesn't get messed up in another foreign adventure that hurts America. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: White House Correspondents' Association Dinner Shooting (Executive Session)
statements.title: White House Correspondents' Association Dinner Shooting (Executive Session)
sentences: I commend law enforcement's swift response to apprehend the gunman, which undoubtedly saved many lives, and that includes the Secret Service.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: U.S. Secret Service (Executive Session)
statements.title: U.S. Secret Service (Executive Session)
sentences: Democrats looked to compromise with Republicans as we pushed for commonsense reforms for ICE and other Agencies, and twice Democrats and Republicans here in the Senate unanimously passed a bill that would fund all of the Agencies within DHS except for ICE and Border Patrol, which are already funded.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, $140 billion for ICE and Border Patrol, zero dollars to lower Americans' costs.

This week, we Democrats are releasing another ``Broken Promises'' report on how Republicans have taken a trillion dollars out of the healthcare system and ripped healthcare away from 15 million Americans all to give tax breaks to the billionaires.
Iran Mr. President, every day this disastrous war continues, Donald Trump digs himself deeper and deeper and deeper into a hole.
The longer Trump takes to extricate himself from Iran, the deeper the hole gets and the harder it will be for him to get out.
The Iranian regime that the United States is trying to negotiate with is even more hardline than when Trump began the war.
Iran's hold over Hormuz has gotten even stronger.
Iran maintains its economic stranglehold on the world, firing on more merchant ships in the Strait of Hormuz earlier today.
Before the war, the regime in Iran, bad as it was, was not as dug in as this one is, making it even harder to negotiate.
I urge Senate Republicans to vote for our War Powers Resolution later today.
Republicans, if Trump won't dig himself out of the hole he has dug, you, Republicans, should pull him out by voting for our War Powers Resolution today.

The head of the FBI, the Nation's top law enforcement officer, spent the entire time getting into fights with reporters about his alleged drunken behavior, his partying, his overall fitness for the job.
Donald Trump has led us to war right now against Iran, a nation known for sophisticated cyber attacks.
Every day that these questions about Patel, his behavior, his character linger, they weaken confidence in the leadership of one of the most important law enforcement agencies in the world.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, first let me thank Senator Baldwin for her outstanding leadership, not only on this resolution but on so many other issues related to Iran as well.
Republican Senators should do Donald Trump a favor and pull him out of the hole he has dug by voting for a War Powers Resolution today.

So I urge Senate Republicans to vote for Senator Baldwin's War Powers Resolution--their fifth opportunity to vote for a War Powers Resolution, and I was proud to be actively involved to sponsor so many of them.
Iran's leadership has become even more militant than before the war.
Iran's hold over Hormuz has gotten even stronger.
Iran maintains its economic stranglehold on the world, firing on more merchant ships in the Strait of Hormuz earlier today.
I urge colleagues on both sides of the aisle to vote yes.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, last week, in Nevada, Donald Trump said ``the war in Iran is going along swimmingly . . . it's perfect.'' From Trump, again: ``The war in Iran is going along swimmingly.'' The truth is that the Trump administration is barely treading water, caught in the riptide of its own incompetence.
He also repeated his threat ``to knock out every single powerplant and every single bridge in Iran.'' That would constitute a war crime.
Four times now, Senate Republicans have voted against our War Powers Resolution, and they have surrendered one of Congress' most important responsibilities under the Constitution to Donald Trump.
Senate Democrats will force a fifth vote on our War Powers Resolution tomorrow, and we will continue to force votes every week this catastrophe continues.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECONCILIATION
statements.title: RECONCILIATION
sentences: Senate Republicans want to pour $75 billion into ICE and Border Patrol without putting any restraints on these rogue Agencies' rampant violence in our streets.
Americans want us to lower their costs, to end this debacle in Iran; to reopen FEMA, the Coast Guard, TSA, and other Agencies Republicans have shut down.
And they do not want us to waste our time and their tax dollars empowering Trump's personal police force.

During reconciliation, Democrats are going to make sure this majority answers to the American people, and we will put a focus on lowering the costs of healthcare and gas and groceries and housing costs and many other costs that have gone up due to Trump's incompetence. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HAITI
statements.title: HAITI
sentences: He repeated vile, baseless stereotypes about Haitians on the campaign trail and tried to strip them of temporary protected status.

I will continue fighting for the Haitian community in New York and beyond to help Haiti make progress on the challenges it faced today, and I look forward to meeting with the Prime Minister. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FEDERAL RESERVE
statements.title: FEDERAL RESERVE
sentences: With inflation rising, costs soaring amidst Trump's disastrous war of choice with Iran, Trump will even put more pressure on the Fed to manipulate interest rates to serve as part of his agenda.
From Trump's blundering war in Iran to his costly and constantly changing tariffs, the Trump administration has poisoned our economy with uncertainty.
I urge Senate Republicans not to proceed with Warsh's confirmation so long as these attacks on the Fed's independence continue, as Senator Tillis has pledged to do.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECONCILIATION
statements.title: RECONCILIATION
sentences: They want to give $140 billion for ICE and Border Patrol without any reforms but zero dollars to lower Americans' costs.
Let me say that again: $140 billion for ICE and Border Patrol--no reforms, no accountability, no strings attached; zero dollars to lower Americans' costs.
Senate Republicans want to appease Donald Trump and Stephen Miller by giving ICE and Border Patrol tens of billions of dollars to continue spreading violence in our streets.
We are going to make them own that decision amendment after amendment, vote after vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: KASH PATEL
statements.title: KASH PATEL
sentences: All of this is made even worse by the reports of Kash Patel's constant jet-setting on the taxpayers' dime, his illegal crusade against Trump's political enemies, and his purge of countless counterintelligence officers focused on Iran just days before Trump launched this reckless war.

We are asking--we are calling on Acting Attorney General Blanche to preserve all records, communications, and other evidence regarding Kash Patel's dangerous behavior before the Trump administration tries to brush it under the rug.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, Donald Trump continues to demonstrate that he has no plan to end his disastrous war of choice with Iran and no idea just how badly the American people are hurting because of him.
Companies and airlines are charging Americans an Iran war surcharge.
Iran fired on commercial ships over the weekend.
The United States seized an Iranian vessel.

Last week, Senate Republicans had their fourth opportunity to support our War Powers Resolution, and for the fourth time, Senate Republicans acquiesced to Donald Trump and gave this historic blunder their stamp of approval.
Tomorrow, Senate Democrats will force a fifth vote on our War Powers Resolution.
We will continue to force votes on our resolution every single week that Trump's war continues.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RECONCILIATION
statements.title: RECONCILIATION
sentences: Any hour now, Republicans are expected to release a budget resolution that adds tens of billions of dollars to the national debt and pumps colossal sums into ICE and Border Patrol without any reforms, all while doing absolutely nothing to lower costs for hard-working Americans.

Remember, last year, in Donald Trump's ``Big Ugly Betrayal,'' Republicans rammed through $75 billion for ICE and tens of billions more for Border Patrol, with virtually no guardrails, minimal training standards, and no real idea of what they were unleashing.
Democrats told our Republican colleagues we needed to work together to rein in ICE and Border Patrol and prevent this kind of violence from happening again.

We put forth commonsense reforms modeled on guardrails law enforcement already follows in the States: no masked agents in unmarked vehicles, no bursting into people's homes without warrants, and body cameras for all agents.
Leader Thune eventually brought a bill to the floor that would fund the rest of the Department of Homeland Security, while leaving ICE and Border Patrol aside, as negotiations on reform continued.

Any moment now, they are expected to release a budget resolution that would tee up more than $75 billion over 3 years for ICE and Border Patrol through reconciliation, while doing nothing--absolutely nothing--to lower costs for hard-working Americans.
And at a moment when President Trump claims we cannot afford Medicare or daycare, Republicans somehow think that we can give ICE and Border Patrol a blank check.
People are suffering because they can't pay for their healthcare needs, and, instead, the Republicans want to send more money to ICE and Border Patrol.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HAITI
statements.title: HAITI
sentences: Despite ongoing violence--gang violence--civil instability, terrible medical infrastructure, and poor food access in Haiti, Trump directed Kristi Noem to strip Haitian immigrants of their TPS--their temporary protected status--disregarding the process Congress set into law.
Last week, a bipartisan majority in the House--bipartisan--passed legislation on a discharge petition to extend temporary protected status for Haitian immigrants.
I will do everything I can to protect the Haitian community.
That is why I will rule XIV this bill, so that the Senate can give this issue the consideration that it deserves without delay.
I urge Leader Thune to put this legislation on the floor. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Working families are hurting worse than before, middle- class families are hurting worse than before; overall, because of Trump's policies, people are hurting.
But thanks to Donald Trump's war in Iran alone, Americans will pay an extra $740 this year just to fill up their tanks.
Third, Donald Trump's ``Big Ugly Bill'' is overwhelmingly skewed to benefit the rich.
It is a tax break for the rich.
Republicans, if you wanted to make the tax cut a middle-class tax cut, put all of the money into the middle class, not a nickel to billionaire-millionaire tax cuts.

And for those of you who live in Las Vegas, don't forget, Trump's disastrous tariff policies and foreign policies are greatly cutting down on tourism in the United States and will greatly cut down on tourism to Las Vegas and Nevada, particularly this summer, the lifeblood of the Las Vegas and Nevada economies.
Thune put the bill on the floor to fund every single Agency within DHS except for ICE and Border Patrol, and it passed unanimously.

Republicans seem so sickened, in fact, by the idea of basic reforms to ICE that they would rather take up weeks of the Senate's time, ramming through a party-line reconciliation package without a shred of the reforms that Americans demand, commonsense reforms that police departments in every part of the country obey: no masks, warrants when you break into someone's home, cooperating with local authorities.

Iran Mr. President, on Iran, there is an old saying that says ``success has a thousand fathers, but failure is an orphan.'' The Republicans who voted against our War Powers Resolution yesterday, they may try and dodge responsibility for Trump's failed war, but they have joint custody over this debate.
All this war has gotten us is a more radical Iranian regime with greater nuclear ambitions, a closed Strait of Hormuz, skyrocketing gas costs, and the ire of the world.
Republicans are kidding themselves if they think they can distance themselves from Trump's Iran blunder by sitting on the sidelines.
Republicans have had four opportunities to support our War Powers Resolution, to finally reassert Congress' constitutional authority, and each time they have said no.
Next week, Republicans will have to answer the question again: Do you want endless war with Iran, yes or no?
Senate Democrats will bring our War Powers Resolution to the floor for a vote next week and every week that Trump's war continues.

Tribute to Assistant Chief Sean P. Gallagher Finally, on Assistant Chief Sean Gallagher, I want to join the rest of the Senate today in saying thank you and goodbye to one of the most beloved members of the Capitol Police, Assistant Chief Sean Gallagher.
After January 6, he led the establishment of the Department's peer support program, and helped create the Howard C. Liebengood Center for Wellness to support officer well-being.
We thank Assistant Chief Gallagher for 25 years of service to the U.S. Capitol Police, to Congress, and to our Nation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IRAN
statements.title: IRAN
sentences: Mr. President, yesterday an Ipsos poll found that fewer than one in four Americans think Trump's war in Iran has been worthwhile.
The Strait of Hormuz is not only closed, it has become an Iranian cash cow.
And Iran's control of the strait is greater today than before when Trump started the war.
Iran's nuclear ambitions have only grown, and the Iranian regime is even more radical than before the war.
He would rather pick a fight with the Pope online than reckon with what is truly on the line right now: the lives of American servicemembers and the livelihood of American working families.
That is why we will force a vote on another War Powers Resolution.

If the Republicans vote no again, we will continue to force votes on these resolutions every week until either this war ends or the Republicans get the courage to stand up to Donald Trump. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WORKING FAMILIES TAX CUT ACT
statements.title: WORKING FAMILIES TAX CUT ACT
sentences: Refunds, on average, have changed only by a third, about $350, and Americans need every penny they can get, but a couple of hundred dollars doesn't go very far on a tax break when the average American family will pay an extra $2,000 on tariff taxes and $740 this year to fill up their tank.
Donald Trump's war in Iran alone has wiped out any tax refund Americans will see this year.

Let me say that again: Donald Trump's war in Iran alone has wiped out any extra tax refund Americans will see this year, and that is not including all the increases they are paying because of tariffs and higher electric bills and what they are doing to healthcare.
Seven in ten Americans say they are paying too much in taxes while the ultrawealthy aren't paying their fair share.
Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill has been a dud for working families, but millionaires got a $300,000 tax cut.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, pursuant to section 1013 of the Department of State Authorization Act, fiscal years 1984 and 1985 (50 U.S.C. 1546a), and in accordance with section 601(b) of the International Security Assistance and Arms Export Control Act, I move to discharge the Committee on Foreign Relations from further consideration of S.J. Res. 123, to direct the removal of United States Armed Forces from hostilities within or against Iran, unless explicitly authorized by a declaration of war or a specific authorization for use of military force.

Mr. President, first, I want to thank my colleagues--my colleague from Illinois, who has done such a good job and knows all about what our veterans go through in the horrors of war; my colleague Tim Kaine, who has been so involved in this issue of War Powers Resolutions for decades--or a decade--and so many others of us who are introducing resolutions on this issue.
Until our Republican colleagues join us, we will continue forcing a vote on our War Powers Resolution, week after week after week.
I urge my Republican colleagues to listen to the majority of Americans who are calling for an end to Trump's wanton war of choice.
Well, I am going to tell my Republican colleagues: They are not going to be able to escape continuing to vote on this.
And so I urge my colleagues to do what they know is the right thing and join us in voting for Senator Duckworth's resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FEDERAL RESERVE
statements.title: FEDERAL RESERVE

statements.title: Iran (Executive Session)
sentences: Mr. President, just days ago, Donald Trump declared his war in Iran a ``total and complete victory. 100 percent.
An adversary that is fueling the war in Ukraine is now benefiting from this chaos.
So let's call Trump's Iran policy for what it is, not Operation Epic Fury, ``Operation Epic Failure.'' ``Operation Epic Failure'' is a much more appropriate name for Trump's war of choice.

If Republicans block it, we will vote again and again and again, every single week, until ``Operation Epic Failure'' ends or Congress does its job and authorizes it--which I know it won't, given how bad this war is--because our troops deserve a mission, not a mess.
We will keep forcing that choice.
We will keep forcing that choice, my Republican colleagues.

sentences: Abroad, Donald Trump is escalating his ill- conceived Iranian incursion, threatening to wipe out an entire civilization, driving up gas prices with no plans and no end in sight.
Here is the bottom line: Stephen Miller and Donald Trump refuse to accept commonsense, bipartisan reforms to ICE and Border Patrol.

They are dragging the Senate through a painful, arduous, and partisan reconciliation process, not because it is the best path but because it is the only way they can avoid accountability for how ICE and Border Patrol operate.
On the SAVE Act, Republicans continue to push forward on their effort to pass the SAVE Act.
While Republicans claim it is a voter ID bill, the insidious truth is, it is a subterfuge for a voter suppression law that would disenfranchise millions of Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
sentences: Republicans have an amendment on the Senate floor dressed up as what they call commonsense voter ID, but let's be very clear what this amendment is: It is a wolf in sheep's clothing, and it is a giant coverup to cover up what their bill really does, which is dramatic voter suppression, kicking 20 million or more people off the rolls without their knowledge or consent.
The point here is not at all about voter ID.
In fact, 99 percent of the SAVE Act doesn't talk about voter ID.
And, once again, the public saw the SAVE Act for what it really is--a voter suppression bill.
It was never in the original bill, and now they pretend it is reasonable policy on voter ID.
The amendment Republicans are pushing today would impose the single strictest voter ID law in America-- stricter than Texas, stricter than Florida, stricter than any State in the country.
Many States already have rules in place for voter ID, and every State has some method to verify the identity of voters.
And it is why voter fraud--this whole bill is hidden, covered up because they say they need to stop voter fraud.
The Heritage Foundation, a rightwing conservative organization, studied voter fraud and found only 77 cases of noncitizen voting in 24 years.
And we are going to upend our whole system of how people register to vote for that because of those 77 cases in 24 years?
Just 0.04 percent of voter verification cases are returned as noncitizens.

This radical amendment would toss out every single voter ID requirement in all 50 States for Federal elections and put in an overly restrictive, one- size-fits-all approach except only a handful of IDs.
Let's talk about vote-by-mail.
Under this ridiculous amendment--this amendment--voters who choose to vote by mail, which is about one in three Americans, guess what they would have to do?
Again, anyone who voted by mail would have to put a voter ID inside the envelope, and the board of elections would have to open it up and see how you voted.
Most people wouldn't like the idea of having to stick a copy of their photo ID with their ballot in the mail.
This requirement is another Trojan horse for trying to weaken and kill vote-by-mail altogether.
Democrats are supportive of commonsense voter ID standards.
Just look at the Freedom to Vote Act, which had the full support of the Democratic caucus.
It set flexible, comprehensive standards based on West Virginia's then-law for voter ID requirements.
The SAVE Act is not about protecting our elections; it is about suppressing the vote.

This long-overdue agreement funds TSA, the Coast Guard, FEMA, CISA, strengthens security at the border and the ports of entry, and keeps Americans safe.
Democrats held firm in our opposition that Donald Trump's rogue and deadly militia should not get more funding without serious reforms, and we will continue to fight for those reforms.

sentences: They are commonsense reforms, reasonable reforms, reforms that police departments across America follow every day.

SAVE America Act Mr. President, finally, on the SAVE Act, which seems to have now been intertwined in these negotiations because of Donald Trump and Republican obeisance to him, let me say this to our Republican colleagues: If you want to shove the SAVE Act into reconciliation, then have at it.
Reconciliation was not, is not, and will not be intended to be a backdoor for sweeping election law; that is not what it is for.
Will Republicans join us to save good-paying energy jobs, strengthen our grid, and undo the damage from Donald Trump's war on clean energy; or will they bow before the throne of Big Oil once again?
This CRA vote is a necessary step to reverse the damage from Donald Trump's anti-clean energy vendetta.
And now, thanks to Donald Trump's idiotic war with Iran, gas prices are at $4 a gallon.
We are going to fight you tooth and nail throughout the reconciliation process every step of the way.
They said: If you give us a billion dollars in campaign contributions, we will get rid of all the deregulation and giveaways they could possibly imagine.
Trump made a promise to the American people on the campaign trail: I will cut your energy bill in half.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
sentences: Mr. President, well, I would first like to talk about the voter ID amendment that Senator Thune talked about on the floor.
Today, Leader Thune is going to appease the MAGA far right with another amendment Republicans claim is about commonsense voter ID.
The bottom line is very simple: 99 percent of this bill has nothing to do with voter ID--what a voter does when they arrive at a polling place to vote.
When the Republicans saw that everyone saw through their so-called voter ID amendment, which is not about voter ID but about suppressing the vote, they got worried.
Republicans say their amendment is a reasonable approach to voter ID.
What Republicans won't tell you is that, first, this MAGA voter ID proposal is more sweeping and restrictive than every State--every State-- Democrat or Republican.
Second, MAGA's voter ID provision would block student, veteran, and other State and Federal IDs.

You can't use your--under this amendment, you can't use your veteran ID, after you served the country and you want to come back and vote, and you show your voter ID, which has been used for so many different legitimate purposes.
Third, Democrats support commonsense voter ID standards.
States require varying forms of voter ID, either at registration, at the polls, or both.
Democrats' Freedom to Vote Act, from a few years ago, set flexible, comprehensive standards based on West Virginia's then-law for voter ID requirements.
Our bill--our proposal in the Democratic Freedom to Vote Act--from a few years back, provides flexibility for States and inclusive options for voters.
That is a commonsense approach to election integrity and voter access.
As I said, this is a giant coverup to disguise the real purpose of the SAVE Act, which is to kick 20 million people off the voter rolls, most of them not even knowing that it has happened to them.
We had made some modest progress over the weekend, before Donald Trump threw a temper tantrum yesterday, demanding that the SAVE Act be part of any deal to pay TSA workers.
Donald Trump, perhaps realizing that Democrats will block voter suppression in the Senate--the SAVE Act--seems to have gotten over his temper tantrum--we hope, for a little while.
This is how authoritarians turn law enforcement into intimidation forces.
Mr. President, let me just finish with this on vote-by-mail.
This morning, the New York Times reported that Donald Trump--who constantly complains about vote-by-mail, who says it is rife with fraud--used vote-by-mail himself in a special election in Florida.
According to Donald Trump, vote-by-mail is cheating when other people use it, but perfectly fine when he does it himself.
Maybe Donald Trump should ask for another amendment to the SAVE Act to create a Presidential exception for mail-in ballots because, apparently, his own rules do not apply to him.
A single mom with three kids and two jobs is just as busy as Donald Trump, and he is doing everything he can to stop her from voting, while voting by mail himself because he is busy.
His decision to vote by mail shows just how hypocritical Donald Trump is about fraud and cheating.
It shows not only Donald Trump's hypocrisy but the complete baselessness of his claims about voter fraud.
And as I mentioned in the beginning, voting for the Thune amendment along those lines is just a coverup to hide what the bill, the SAVE Act, really does.
We await to hear from them in a written proposal that we will review, because, right now, the situation at our airports is untenable.

sentences: Yesterday, instead of considering legislation to tackle inflation or end the war in Iran, MAGA Republicans wasted Senate floor time on a radical culture-war amendment that went nowhere.

And that shows you, when they are voting yes on amendments that won't actually pay them because it won't pass because it is tied to all the other complications in ICE--including the desire that American people have that we must have warrants when you bust into someone's home and that the police should not wear masks--they say they will only vote for TSA agents if we get rid of those things, if we don't make sure they have to wear masks.
Iran Mr. President, now let's talk about the disastrous war in Iran, causing so much havoc, so much chaos, and raising everybody's gas prices and prices on so much else.
He lifts sanctions on two of the states that are enemies to us in so many ways--Iran and Russia--so they can go after our own troops and allies.

Lifting sanctions on Iran and Russia so they can go after our troops and our allies--it is the dictionary definition of ``asinine.'' Donald Trump's military strategy is like watching a snake eat its own tail.
The American people do not want a war with Iran that has no end.
But we are going to keep at it.
We will keep doing this and doing this until the Republicans see the light and feel the pressure that they are holding up payment and relent.

Vote ``fund TSA with no strings attached.'' Republicans, in essence, say they want to reopen all of DHS but only if there are no changes to ICE and Border Patrol when they vote.
I urge Republicans to support my motion.
So in conclusion, I urge my Republican colleagues: Vote yes if you want to pay TSA.

statements.title: DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026--Motion to Proceed--Resumed
sentences: SAVE America Act Mr. President, on SAVE, the Senate is in session today, and all we are really doing is wasting time on a voter suppression bill written only to appease the fringe elements of the MAGA base.

With so many problems facing our country, the cost of living so high, with people struggling to make ends meet, with the war going on in Iran, Republicans instead are choosing to spend time making it harder for citizens to vote.
This is exactly what the SAVE Act is designed to do.
Do not listen to the Republican talking points about voter ID.
Underneath the surface, the SAVE Act is a voter purge bill.
Most of its core elements don't even talk about voter ID.
They want to make it harder to register to vote than it is to register to buy an AR- 15.

They want Americans' information to be run through an algorithm that Elon Musk and DOGE could use to kick eligible American citizens off the voter rolls without them even knowing they were kicked off.
When you show up at the polling place, they say: Mr. Jones, Ms. Smith, you are no longer on the registry.
They want to end vote-by-mail, end registering online, end registering on college campuses and in churches, and even end registering at the DMV, where, of course, you have to show ID.
That is what the SAVE Act is, and Republicans know it.
Iran Mr. President, on Iran, thanks to Donald Trump's war with Iran, gas prices are now nearing $4 a gallon.
He is speaking like a billionaire.
Meanwhile, the war with Iran is expanding.
Iranian strikes on Qatar's energy structure have knocked out 17 percent of the country's LNG export capacity.
We should never accept giving Donald Trump a blank check to wage war in Iran in perpetuity.

Today, he called NATO a ``paper tiger'' and called our allies ``cowards.'' How does he expect to form a coalition, which he says he needs, if he is just going to spend his time calling them names--calling our allies names?
He has spent years trashing our allies, insulting them, threatening NATO, undermining the very alliances that have kept us strong for generations.
Republicans are saying: Unless you pass ICE as-is, without reform, we are not going to help the TSA workers get paid and reduce the lines at the airport.
We are going to hold this vote tomorrow, and I urge my Republican colleagues to vote yes.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Mr. President, well, Donald Trump promised an easy and quick war with Iran.
Three weeks later in Iran, just the opposite of what Trump promised is happening.

Last night, a stunning report in the Washington Post revealed that the Pentagon has reportedly discussed with the White House requesting $200 billion--$200 billion--from Congress to bankroll Donald Trump's war with Iran.
Two hundred billion dollars so Donald Trump can go to war with Iran is preposterous and unacceptable.
Let's be very clear: If Trump wants $200 billion, that means he believes we might be in a war with Iran for a very, very long time.
It is more than we have spent all together in Ukraine.
But instead--instead--the Trump administration reportedly wants $200 billion to go to war with Iran.
Well, if you are a billionaire, you don't care.
If you are a billionaire, you don't think such a large increase every time you pull up at the pump is bad.
Republicans can try to wash their hands of Donald Trump's war with Iran, but they will not escape responsibility.
The American people and Democrats will hold Republicans accountable for willingly supporting Donald Trump's reckless, aimless, chaotic war in Iran.
SAVE America Act Mr. President, on the SAVE Act, Republicans want to waste yet another day on a radical piece of legislation that hardly anyone outside the MAGA fringe even cares about, the SAVE Act.
The longer the SAVE Act stays before the Senate, the more obvious it becomes it is not a voter ID bill.
The SAVE Act says no more vote-by-mail, no more driver's licenses to register, no registering online or on campus or at church.

The SAVE Act would force every State in America to send its voter rolls to the Department of Homeland Security, an Agency that has nothing to do with administering elections and everything to do with Musk and DOGE and incompetence at the top.
Those voter rolls would then be screened by an algorithm designed by Musk and DOGE to supposedly root out noncitizens from the rolls.
Now, MAGA Republicans keep talking about the SAVE Act in terms of protecting elections.
She said it was about--Kristi Noem said--the SAVE Act is about making sure only the right people get to vote--the right people get to vote.
So anyone who thinks this is just some benign effort to tell the small number of illegal immigrants--make sure they are not on the rolls.
Well, the SAVE Act gives us some clues.
Deep in the SAVE Act, there is one blanket exception for the SAVE Act's draconian restrictions, only one--one exception.
It is overwhelmingly Republican, and it is the only State that right now does not require any form of voter registration.
Look, MAGA claims of voter fraud are utter garbage, but according to the ultraright Heritage Foundation, North Dakota had 12 instances of improper voting.
It is almost as if the goal of the SAVE Act has nothing to do with securing elections.
This is how you write a bill designed to give Republicans a naked, partisan advantage, and it is what the SAVE Act does.
But we will continue to expose just how radical and ugly it is.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Continued
statements.title: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Continued
sentences: Republicans could focus on whether Americans can afford groceries or on lowering healthcare premiums or bringing down childcare costs or fixing our power grid.
This SAVE Act is not about voter ID.
In fact, the original bill didn't even have a sentence about voter ID, and they had to put it in at the last minute so it could meet their subterfuge argument.
Democrats support commonsense voter ID, but this bill is not that-- not at all.
The core of the bill is handing the voter rolls over to DHS, putting them through an algorithm designed by DOGE and Musk that supposedly knocks out illegal immigrants from voting.
But the evidence is almost no illegal immigrants vote, and on an experiment in a county of Missouri, more than half the people knocked out were American citizens, using this algorithm.
And it is all based on one fact: that Donald Trump has lied that our elections are rife with voter fraud.

Even the Wall Street Journal--no friend of Democrats; certainly, no friend of mine--said in an editorial yesterday--the Wall Street Journal said the President's voter fraud claims ``aren't backed by hard evidence.'' And yet that is what this bill is supposedly all about.
The SAVE Act makes voting harder and makes registration much harder for U.S. citizens--for U.S. citizens.
We know that there are discussions about ICE and Border Patrol that we haven't resolved, but why hold TSA hostage?
Thirteen U.S. servicemembers have been killed since the start of the Iran war.
Trump's war in Iran is turning into a disaster, and there is no end in sight.
Today, we are pushing another War Powers Resolution led by Senator Booker, and I want to thank him for his leadership.
We will debate this bill for as long as Republicans want because the more time we spend on this bill, the more Senate Democrats will expose it for what it really is.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAVE America Act (Executive Session)
statements.title: SAVE America Act (Executive Session)
sentences: Mr. President, this afternoon, Republicans will move to bring a pernicious, radical bill before the Senate, the so-called SAVE America Act.

Trump says: Pass the SAVE Act, and it will ``guarantee the midterms.'' Imagine manipulating the electoral process to try to make himself the winner when he thinks he is going to lose--not surprising, I suppose, from Donald Trump.
I don't remember MAGA Republicans screaming about stolen elections and voter fraud after the 2024 election that they won.
Senate Democrats will never allow the SAVE Act to pass this Chamber.
The SAVE Act is not about voter identification; it is about voter suppression.
Under the SAVE Act, every single State would be required to share its voter rolls with the Department of Homeland Security--something even many Republican States do not want to do.
Those rolls would be reviewed by a system designed by none other than Elon Musk and his DOGE, using an algorithm that has already been shown to be deeply flawed.
You can't reregister that day, especially with the onerous requirements for registration in the SAVE Act.
Under the bill, Americans would have to run through an obstacle course of redtape unlike anything we have ever seen in voter registration.
Meanwhile, say goodbye to some of the safest, most convenient, and most effective ways to register to vote.
Many red States love vote-by-mail.
How does getting rid of vote-by-mail--something red States do, something blue States do-- strengthen democracy?
The SAVE Act is not about election integrity; it is about voter suppression, plain and simple.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Let me be very clear: The SAVE Act is not a voter ID bill.
It could purge millions of American citizens from the voter rolls through a screening algorithm designed by Elon Musk's DOGE squad.
It would kill online voter registration.
The SAVE Act also rejects the most common forms of ID for anyone trying to register.
The most common ID forms for anyone to register are rejected in the SAVE Act for the first time in just about every State.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAVE America Act (Executive Session)
statements.title: SAVE America Act (Executive Session)
sentences: They are conspiring with Donald Trump to undermine democracy and disenfranchise millions of Americans by pushing the SAVE Act.
Not a single Democrat will support the SAVE Act.
Do they try to work with Democrats to lower grocery costs, stop the Iran war, help lower people's energy bills?
That is exactly what the SAVE Act is all about.
He said if Republicans pass the SAVE Act, ``it'll guarantee the midterms.'' He is saying: Fix the election so that we can win.
Now, MAGA Republicans keep calling this voter ID, but the SAVE Act is not a voter ID bill; it is a voter suppression bill.
The SAVE Act would make it easier to buy an AR-15 than to register to vote.
Republicans won't tell Americans, for example, that under the SAVE Act, States would be required to hand over voter records to be screened through a DHS system rebuilt by Elon Musk's DOGE squad.
Republicans won't tell Americans that their bill would wipe out the most common ways Americans register to vote.
No more voter registration drives at churches or on college campuses.
Under the SAVE Act, Americans would be forced to register in person even though only 6 percent of Americans registered in person to vote in 2022, and Republicans want to make this the only option.
And now, Donald Trump says he doesn't even want vote by mail.
Put simply, the SAVE Act is designed to make it harder to vote and easier to steal an election.
It is a radical bill, and if Republicans try to burn time on this legislation here on the floor, we will oppose them for as long as it takes.
